3f99f655950eda35de0a.title: HIV Customer Representative - New Orleans Territory Mirror
3f99f655950eda35de0a.description:
Job Description
  
  
The HIV Customer Representative is a key member of the Customer Team and plays a critical role in supporting our Company's customer centric business model. This position is responsible for working with the Customer Team to understand and identify customer needs, supporting pull-through activities relative to the customer strategy, keeping with our Company's values and standards as governed by our policies and ensuring that our Company is viewed as demonstrating better health outcomes to healthcare professionals and their patients. The HIV Customer Representative demonstrates professionalism and leadership by modeling the required knowledge for successful execution of all Field Sales competencies.
  
  
**Territory Information:**  

* This is a field-based sales position that is responsible for covering the New Orleans Territory Vacancy - Mirror position.
* This role also includes and is not limited to All of Louisiana with majority of business in the New Orleans/Baton Rouge metroplex.
* The ideal location to reside is within this territory or within a reasonable commuting distance to those workload centers.
* Travel (%) varies based on candidate’s location within the geography.

**Primary Responsibilities:**  
Communicates product information in a way that's meaningful and relevant to each individual customer; customizes discussions and client interactions based on understanding of customer's needs.
  
Engages in informed discussions about products with HCP customers – knowing when/how to seek and provide additional information.
  
Within select customer accounts, acts as primary point of contact for customer, meets with key customers/personnel to understand practice structure, business model, key influencers (IDS, ADAP, DOC, VAs, DOH)/network structure, customer needs and identifies business opportunities.
  
For select customer accounts/HCPs, coordinates with customer team to develop customer strategy – outlining strategy for interactions/ relationship, solutions and potential offerings for customer.
  
Shares learnings and best practices from one customer to help other customers meet their needs.
  
Demonstrates a focus on better health outcomes (considers the HCP & patient experience).
  
Provides input into resource allocation decisions across customers.
  
Identifies and selects programs/services available in the library of our "resources" to address customer needs.
  
Maintains current understanding of practice structure, business model, key influencers/ network structure and makes information available to relevant stakeholders.
  
Influences beyond their specific geography or product area.
  
Embraces and maximizes new technological capabilities and channels to engage customers.
  
Engages in all job responsibilities and activities with the highest standards of ethics and integrity, with particular emphasis on compliance with all relevant laws, policies and regulations.
  
  
**HIV Specific:**  

* The HIV Customer Representative demonstrates the ability to execute at each stage of the sales process. This role creates a compelling and logical rationale in positioning our Company's HIV products versus the competition by focusing on appropriate patient types and use of supportive approved resources.
* Demonstrates the ability to stay ahead of market trends, assesses impact of dynamics on current business state and makes proactive recommendations to meet the future needs of the business. Demonstrates innovation, resilience and is able to adapt to ambiguous/evolving business environments.
* Demonstrates advanced ability to ask strategic, insightful questions to obtain information on customer healthcare needs. Uses the insights to position HIV products and collaborates with customers on focused and customized business strategy.
* Demonstrates the ability to identify customer/market segments and industry conditions in local market. Special emphasis on Specialty Pharmacy to leverage business opportunities and understanding of HIV products distribution channels/challenges.
* Demonstrates the ability to drive results by appropriately managing the total Virology product portfolio by prioritizing individual opportunities and plan execution through customer segmentation, targeting and business analysis.
* Articulates the complexities of the HIV payer environment, recognizing the role each stakeholder plays in the ability to access our company's Virology product portfolio.
* Demonstrates the ability to apply understanding of account needs and inter-dependencies in order to develop and execute account plans. Collaborates and models teamwork with extended members of the Virology Account Team (CLs, CTLs, Managed Care, Marketing) in the development of long-term account plans and customer centric solutions to improve value for both customers and patients.
* Demonstrates the ability to embrace and maximize current and future technological capabilities and multi-channel opportunities to engage customers.
* Demonstrates high-level collaboration skills to optimally maximize customer interactions and territory management with cross-functional Virology and non-Virology stakeholders such as Community Liaisons, IDS executives, fellow District members etc.
* Demonstrates the ability to forge and manage business relationships with difficult to access customers in a “no sample” environment.
* Demonstrates ability to function effectively and employ a “business owner mindset” during business cycles undergoing a high degree of change, including flexing across customer segments, product portfolios, and working in flexible matrix configurations.
* Demonstrates high-level compliance with all Company policies and procedures.

**Position Qualifications:**  
**Minimum Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree with at least 2 years Sales experience OR a minimum of high school diploma with at least 6 years of equivalent experience which could include professional sales, experience in marketing, military or healthcare/scientific field that is not sales related (pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical devices).
* Valid Driver's license.
* Willing to travel within the assigned territory to visit customers in-person and for national sales meetings/conferences.

**Preferred Experience and Skills:**  

* Minimum of two (2) years working in one or more of the following areas: account management or sales experience working with Infectious Disease customers, with a preference for HIV product experience and/or launch experience.
* Preference for specialty sales experience across multiple specialty markets with a preference for launch experience.
* Experience in pharma, biotech or medical device sales.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing plans for engaging customers and meeting customer needs.
* Demonstrated success in establishing, developing and maintaining relationships.
* Prior experience working in a highly regulated industry or environment where compliance to laws and policies is critical.
* Account experience working in complex hospital systems, teaching Institutions and community hospitals.
* Demonstrated skill set to identify account inter-dependencies and build partnerships with key stakeholders/departments.
* Experience with complex payer environments, recognizing the role each stakeholder plays in the ability to access the product portfolio, especially pharmacy stakeholders.
* Current disease state customers acknowledge individual as a trusted and reliable representative.
* Experience interacting with scientific thought leaders and developing advocates across an adoption continuum.
* Demonstrated ability to develop customer relationships in a challenging-to-access or “no sampling” environment.
* High level of business acumen and account management skills.
* Current relationships with key opinion leaders within designated account preferred.
* Leadership, planning and organization, self-motivation and initiative, ability to learn, understand and convey complex information.
* Understanding of the value and importance of approaching job responsibilities with ethics and integrity and working in a highly compliant environment.

**Required Skills:**  
Hospital Sales, Sales Calls, Sales Metrics, Sales Pipeline Management, Sales Presentations, Sales Process Management, Sales Territory Management, Sales Training, Strategic Alliances, Unique Selling Proposition

587873122c0752e0c4ab.description:
**Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!**

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

* **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
* **Embracing New Ideas:** Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
* **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

**The Opportunity:**

**ENTRY LEVEL CAREER OPPORTUNITY OFFERING:**

* Bonus Incentives
* Paid Certifications
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Comprehensive Benefits
* Career Advancement
* This position pays between $17.00 - $18.15/hr based on experience

**\*\*\*This position is an onsite role, and candidates must be able to work on-site at Tower - St. Christopher's Hospital for Children in Philadelphia, PA.**

**The Opportunity:**

We are searching for the next Patient Access Specialist champion. This role is responsible for performing admitting duties for all patients admitted for services at the hospital. They are responsible for performing these functions while meeting the mission and goals of the organization and all regulatory compliance requirements. The Representative will work within the policies and processes as they are being performed across the entire organization.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Patient Access staff are responsible for assigning accurate MRNs, completing medical necessity / compliance checks, providing proper patient instructions, collecting insurance information, receiving, and processing physician orders, and utilizing an overlay tool while providing excellent customer service as measured by Press Ganey.
* Operates the telephone switchboard to relay incoming, outgoing, and inter-office calls as applicable.
* They are to adhere to policies and provide excellent customer service in these interactions with the appropriate level of compassion.
* Patient Access staff will be held accountable for point of service goals as assigned.
* Patient Access staff are responsible for the utilization of quality auditing and reporting systems to ensure accounts are corrected. These activities may include accounts for other employees, departments, and facilities. Conducts audits of accounts and assures that all forms are completed accurate, timely to meet audit standards and provides statistical data to Patient Access leadership.
* Patient Access Staff are responsible for the pre-registration of patient accounts prior to patient visits. This may include inbound and outbound calling to obtain demographic, insurance, and other patient information including the patient financial liabilities including collecting point of service collections as well as past due balances including payment plan options.
* The Patient Access Staff explains general consent for treatment forms to the patient/guarantor/legal guardian, obtains necessary signatures and witness’s name. Explains and distributes patient education documents, such as Important Message from Medicare, Important Message from Tricare, Observation Forms, MOON form, Consent forms, and all forms implemented for future services.
* Reviews eligibility responses in insurance verification system and appropriately selects the applicable insurance plan code, enters benefit data into system to support POS (Point of Service Collections) and billing processes to assist with a clean claim rate.
* Responsible for accurately screening of medical necessity using the Advanced Beneficiary Notice (ABN) software to inform Medicare patients of possible non-payment of test by Medicare and distribution of the ABN as appropriate. Responsible for distribution and documentation of other designated forms and pamphlets.

**Experience We Love:**

* 1+ years of customer service experience
* Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.

**Minimum Education:**

* High School Diploma/GED Required

**Certifications:**

* CRCR Required within 9 months of hire (Company Paid)

3511ed18b8a829949404.description:
Product Support & Resolution Principal Ops Coordinator, Empower Dealer Success Team - Work from Home

**Job Description:**

Due to the amazing growth and future projections of Capital One's Navigator Platform, and the need to invest in world class service for our valuable dealer partners, we are looking to expand the footprint of Empower Dealer Success (EDS) operations. The associates in this role will engage in dealer resolutions, Dealer Navigator support, call/chat, product support, and billing.

**Responsibilities:**

* Execute E2E (End-to-End) billing support
* Execute E2E Dealer Navigator and product support - Call/Chat Center with inbound and outbound calls
* Utilize all available resources and P&P for executing effective onboarding and servicing across all case and task types
* Establish and foster relationships with EDS vendors - web hosts and inventory aggregators
* Apply effective time management skills to manage daily workload
* Investigate issues and apply sound judgment to detect and mitigate product defects, dealer dissatisfaction, and areas of improvement
* Respond promptly and professionally to internal and external customers and discern when to appropriately escalate
* Exercise exceptional communication skills to optimize each contact with sales, external vendors, and dealer partners
* Responsible for continuous improvement of job knowledge by exercising active listening and engagement
* Establish and ensure compliance with departmental standards and processes to increase production and accommodate work volumes toward enhanced customer satisfaction
* Closely partner with product teams and provide Subject Matter Expert understanding and updates to the team and written documentation
* Participate in special projects and ad hoc requests as needed

**Job Level:** Principal Coordinator

**Department Hours:** Monday - Saturday 8:00am-7:00pm CST & Sunday 11:00am-5:00pm CST

**Basic Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent certification
* At least 3 years of customer service or call center experience
* At least 2 years of experience working in the financial industry
* At least 1 year of experience using Google Sheets

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* At least 1 year of auto finance experience
* At least 1 year of system activations, inventory management, or billing experience
* At least 6 months of experience using JIRA or Salesforce

**Work from Home Technology Requirements**

* Secure home office environment that is free from background noise and distractions
* Reliable private internet connection that is not supplied via cellular data or hotspot is required
  + A private network that is password protected where you have ownership or line of site sight to every device on the network
  + Internet service must be provided by Cable or Fiber Internet Service Providers (ISP)
  + Hotspots and satellite services are prohibited and do not meet performance criteria required for optimal agent/customer interactions
  + Associates must maintain a minimum of 100 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload speed from their internet provider
  + To validate ISP speeds from a Chrome browser, go to www.google.com, type Speed Test and run from the Google landing page
* Both Hardwire and WiFi internet connections are acceptable as long as speed and security requirements are met

Capital One reserves the right to request proof of internet provider, speed and service package from the associate. Requirements are subject to change, as new systems and technology is delivered. Capital One reserves the right to modify internet service requirements with sixty (60) days notice. Internet Service Provider specs can change by provider and location within the US. If you are experiencing consistent issues with internet stability Capital One reserves the right to ask the agent to upgrade internet service to ensure a good customer experience.

**Work from Home Location Requirements**

This role is 100% work from home. We are unable to consider applicants who do not meet the required Capital One Work at Home compatible internet access or who live in the states of California, Hawaii, or US territories. Work from home U.S. based associates are not permitted to work internationally, outside of the continental United States (i.e. Hawaii or U.S. Territories), or California.

**At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer)**

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Remote (Regardless of Location): $56,800 - $64,800 for Principal Ops Prod Coor  
Plano, TX: $56,800 - $64,800 for Principal Ops Prod Coor

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Job Posting Title

**BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE**

**Job Description**

Custom Truck One Source has changed the way the industry looks at specialized trucks and heavy equipment solutions. With sales, rentals, aftermarket parts and service, equipment customization, remanufacturing, financing solutions, and asset disposal, our team of experts, vast equipment breadth and integrated network of locations across North America offer superior service and unmatched efficiency for our customers. Your success is what's next with Custom Truck One Source.

**Summary:**

Business Development Representatives (“BDR”) are responsible for qualifying both inbound and outbound sales leads at the initial stages in the sales funnel. They must research potential clients, connect with, and educate prospects before handing them off to the closers of the sales team.

* The outbound process requires the BDR to reach out to prospects in the form of cold calls, emails, or social networks. This process allows BDR to personalize their outreach for the first touch point, but many people don’t like being contacted without having preciously shown interest.
* The inbound process is directed toward prospects who have shown interest in our product or service by reaching out to the company via phone call, email, or request for additional information online.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* *75 calls and or emails per day*
* *Follow-up on inbound marketing leads by identifying qualified opportunities with appropriate levels of information at the right time for interested prospects.*
* *Be responsible for educating and developing prospects leading to hand-off to sales teams*
* *Create target prospects lists and penetrate key accounts*
* *Cold call prospects generated by variety of outside sources*
* *Answer incoming customer calls and send them in the correct direction*
* *Identify key players, researching and obtaining business requirements, and presenting solutions to begin sales cycle*
* *Develop a knowledge of the company’s product*
* *Monitor account creation to ensure that no duplicate accounts are created*
* *Work with a specified region to help grow sales*
* *Profile strategic accounts identifying key individuals, research and obtain business requirements, then presenting solutions to start the sales cycle*
* *Set appointments for Local Sales team when a lead reaches a qualified stage*
* *Nurture new marketing leads by educating and developing prospects until they are ready to speak with a field sales rep*
* *Collaborate with sales and marketing team members on strategic sales approach*
* *Ensure successful follow through of sales cycle by maintaining accurate activity and lead qualification information in CRM application*

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

Qualifications include:

* *Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.*
* *Excellent sales and negotiation skills.*
* *Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.*
* *Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.*
* *Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment.*
* *Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.*

**Physical Requirements:**

* *A positive attitude and willingness to maintain a professional demeanor with clients and team members is essential to this position.*
* *Ability to work around common office equipment, supplies and environments.*
* *Oral Expression and comprehension ' The ability to communicate information and ideas in speaking so others will understand. The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences. The ability to speak clearly so others can understand you.*
* *Written Comprehension and expression ' The ability to read and understand information and ideas presented in writing. The ability to communicate information and ideas in writing so others will understand.*
* *Reasoning ' The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense. The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing there is a problem.*
* *Sitting – The ability to sit or stand for long periods of time while performing duties.*
* *Lifting – The ability to bend, stoop and lift up to 10 lbs.*

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

**Location:** **Remote (equipment provided)** 
**Hours:** **Evenings and Weekends (approx. 5-9 PM ET M-F, 9-5 ET on Saturdays)** 
**Compensation:** **$22-$24/hr** 
 
**About the role**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Havenside is looking for a friendly, organized phone professional to connect with people who have asked about our services through Facebook and Instagram ads. You will often be the first person they speak with at Havenside, so your goal is to make that first conversation helpful, clear, and welcoming.  
  
On each call, you will follow a proven script to learn what the customer needs, confirm they are a good fit, and book an onsite appointment on our sales calendar. Your notes give our sales team the context they need before they arrive. Call volume is modest at first and will grow over time. Between calls, you will help our sales and customer service teams with administrative work.  
  
No prior experience with Havenside is needed. We will train you on our services, the script, and our tools.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Respond to new leads:** Answer inbound calls and make timely outbound calls to people who submitted an inquiry through our Meta ads. Follow up with leads you have not yet reached.
* **Qualify each lead:** Use our script to understand each person's needs, timeline, and location, and to answer common questions about Havenside.
* **Book onsite appointments:** Schedule qualified leads directly on the sales calendar, and confirm the date, time, address, and contact details before ending the call.
* **Keep clear records:** Write accurate notes for every call and update each lead's status so the sales team is fully prepared.
* **Support the team:** When calls are slow, help sales and customer service with data entry, lead list cleanup, appointment confirmations, and follow-up messages.
* **Share what you hear:** Pass along common questions and objections to help us improve the script and the customer experience.

**What you bring**
------------------

**Required**

* At least 1 year of experience in sales, call center, customer service, or appointment setting.
* A warm, professional phone manner and the ability to follow a script while sounding natural.
* Strong listening skills and fast, accurate note-taking.
* Comfort with online calendars, email, and web-based tools.
* Availability for the full schedule: weekday evenings and Saturdays as listed above.
* A quiet, distraction-free workspace at home and reliable high-speed internet.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Nice to have**

* Experience calling leads from social media or online ads.
* Experience using a CRM (such as HubSpot or Salesforce) or scheduling software.
* Background in home services, residential sales, or in-home appointment setting.
* Fluency in English and Spanish.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Paid training on Havenside's services, our qualification script, and our scheduling process.
* A company-provided laptop, headset, and phone.
* $22–$24 per hour, based on experience.
* Fully remote work on a steady, predictable schedule.
* Valuable sales and lead-qualification experience in a growing program.

  
*Havenside is an E-Verify and equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

**SUMMARY:**

**Leverage your solar expertise to help power the future of commercial solar.**

  

**About the Opportunity:**

Greentech Renewables is seeking a driven, relationship-focused sales professional who understands the commercial solar landscape, knows how to navigate project opportunities, and can turn established industry relationships into long-term business partnerships.

This person is proactive and will help to expand our presence in the commercial solar market around Colorado. This role is ideal for an established business development professional with an existing network of commercial solar developers, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) firms, and other key industry partners.

You will be responsible for developing strategic relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and driving revenue growth by connecting commercial solar projects with the products, solutions, and distribution support they need to succeed.

  
  

**Why Greentech Renewables?**

At Greentech Renewables, you'll have the opportunity to help grow commercial solar distribution by connecting industry relationships, technical solutions, and reliable product availability. You'll work alongside a team committed to supporting customers and advancing renewable energy projects.

This is an opportunity for a business development professional who wants to make a measurable impact, expand their market presence, and build lasting partnerships in a growing industry.

**Ready to turn your commercial solar relationships into business growth? We'd love to hear from you.**

**REPORTS TO:** Profit Center Manager

* **Qualifications:**

  + Demonstrated experience in outside sales, business development, or strategic account management, preferably within commercial solar, renewable energy, or electrical distribution.
  + **An established network of relationships with commercial solar developers and commercial EPCs.**
  + A proven ability to generate new business, develop strategic accounts, and convert relationships into revenue.
  + Understanding of the commercial solar project lifecycle, including project development, procurement, bidding, and equipment sourcing.
  + Strong relationship-building, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
  + A self-starter mentality with the ability to independently manage a sales territory, prioritize opportunities, and drive results.
  + Experience managing a sales pipeline, forecasting revenue, and developing territory growth strategies.
  + Willingness to travel regularly for customer meetings, site visits, industry events, and collaboration with other branch locations.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

  + You already have trusted relationships with commercial solar developers and EPC decision-makers.
  + You understand how commercial solar projects move from development to construction and equipment procurement.
  + You know how to identify projects early, influence purchasing decisions, and position a distribution partner for success.
  + You are comfortable building a territory, opening doors, and creating opportunities rather than relying solely on inbound leads.
  + You are a strategic relationship builder who balances immediate sales opportunities with long-term account growth.

Supervising Projects dept. and Sales dept. employees to achieve common goals of sales and profit and customer service levels provided by the PC Manager.

Business hours are 7am-5pm (M-F)

**Location**:

**About the Role**

The Student Services Specialist is the first point of contact for prospective and current students. You’ll answer inbound calls, emails, and chats, and help students through the early stages of enrollment: applying, registering for courses, and getting their documents in on time. This is a mid-level, service-focused role for someone who likes solving problems quickly, keeps clean records, and knows the rules well enough to give students the right answer the first time.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Student Support**
  + Answer inbound questions from prospective students and their families by phone, email, and chat, and respond quickly
  + Hold discovery conversations to check applicant qualifications and find the right program fit
  + Guide students through applying, enrolling, and the steps that follow, making sure required documents come in on time
* **Program and Policy Knowledge**
  + Learn university programs, policies, and the student life cycle in depth so you can give accurate, relevant answers
  + Spot roadblocks in the student life cycle, escalate them, and suggest fixes that make the process easier for students
* **Records and Systems**
  + Keep detailed, accurate records in the CRM and Five9
  + Follow institutional policies so every record stays clean and compliant
* **Teamwork and Process Improvement**
  + Work with admissions, financial aid, and academic advising so students get a smooth experience from start to finish
  + Find ways to improve how things run and share your ideas with the team

**What You Bring**

* High school diploma or GED required
* 1–2 years of experience in higher ed admissions, recruitment, customer service, or a related field
* Contact center or customer support experience preferred
* Bilingual skills preferred (English/Spanish)
* Clear, professional speaking and writing, with the ability to explain complex information simply
* Comfort with Google Workspace, CRM platforms, and dialer/phone systems
* Ability to juggle multiple tasks in a high-volume, deadline-driven setting
* Sharp attention to detail and strong organizational skills
* Good problem-solving skills and a commitment to great customer service
* Ability to stay calm and professional in a fast-paced, transactional environment
* Strong communication and time-management skills, along with comfort learning and switching between multiple tech platforms, given the remote environment
* Ability to work at a computer for long periods

**Why This Role**

For many students, you’ll be the first person they talk to on their way to a degree. A quick, clear answer can be the difference between a student who enrolls and one who gives up. You’ll help students get started on the right foot and help our partners turn more interest into enrollments, and you’ll have a direct say in making the process better for every student who comes after.

**Vice President of Clinical Operations – Hospice**
===================================================

**Vitality Hospice & Palliative Care**

Full-Time | Exempt | In-Person

**New Position**

### **Lead with Purpose. Inspire Teams. Make a Difference.**

Are you an experienced hospice or healthcare operations leader ready to take the next step in your career?

At Vitality Hospice & Palliative Care, we're passionate about providing compassionate, patient-centered end-of-life care while creating a workplace where employees feel supported, valued, and empowered to succeed.

We're seeking a **Vice President of Clinical Operations** to provide strategic leadership, oversee hospice operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and guide our interdisciplinary teams toward continued success.

This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated leader who thrives on building strong teams, improving operational performance, and making a meaningful difference in the lives of patients, families, and employees.

### **Why Join Vitality Hospice?**

At Vitality, we believe great patient care starts with great leadership. We offer a collaborative, supportive environment where your experience, ideas, and leadership can make a lasting impact.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Competitive Salary
* Performance Bonus Opportunities
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid Holidays
* Mileage Reimbursement
* Tapcheck – Access Earned Wages Before Payday
* Pet Insurance
* Employee Referral Bonus Program
* Professional Development & Career Growth Opportunities
* Employee Recognition & Team Appreciation Events
* Supportive Leadership Team and Positive Work Environment
* Monday–Friday Day Schedule (with rotating administrative on-call responsibilities)

### **Position Overview**

The Vice President of Clinical Operations provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure the delivery of high-quality hospice care while supporting organizational growth, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.

This role oversees daily operations, interdisciplinary team performance, staffing, quality improvement initiatives, and financial performance.

The ideal candidate is a strong healthcare leader with hospice experience, excellent communication skills, and the ability to motivate teams while maintaining a compassionate, patient-focused approach.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic & Operational Leadership**

* Provide leadership and oversight of daily hospice operations.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve efficiency, quality, and organizational performance.
* Partner with executive leadership to support company goals and continued growth.
* Participate in the administrative on-call rotation.
* Promote exceptional patient and family experiences.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Recruit, hire, mentor, coach, and develop clinical and non-clinical team members.
* Oversee interdisciplinary teams, including nursing, hospice aides, social workers, chaplains, bereavement coordinators, and support staff.
* Conduct performance evaluations and support employee development.
* Build a positive, collaborative, and accountable team culture.
* Encourage employee engagement, retention, and professional growth.

**Regulatory Compliance & Quality Improvement**

* Ensure compliance with Medicare Hospice Conditions of Participation, New Jersey hospice regulations, and company policies.
* Maintain survey readiness and support accreditation requirements.
* Oversee quality improvement initiatives, documentation standards, and operational audits.
* Identify opportunities to improve patient care, regulatory performance, and organizational processes.

**Financial & Resource Management**

* Oversee staffing levels, scheduling, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Monitor budgets, expenses, and resource utilization.
* Manage costs associated with durable medical equipment (DME), pharmaceuticals, and medical supplies.
* Support financial performance while maintaining high standards of patient care.

**Interdisciplinary Collaboration & Growth**

* Support effective interdisciplinary team meetings and care coordination.
* Promote collaboration between clinical teams, physicians, and community partners.
* Build and maintain relationships with referral sources and healthcare organizations.
* Partner with leadership to identify opportunities for service improvement and organizational growth.

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* Proven leadership experience in hospice, home health, or healthcare operations.
* Strong experience managing interdisciplinary teams and daily operations.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage priorities, and improve operational performance.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and current auto insurance.
* Ability to travel between office locations and healthcare facilities as needed.

**Preferred**

* Previous hospice leadership or executive management experience.
* Experience overseeing multiple departments or healthcare teams.
* Knowledge of Medicare Hospice Conditions of Participation and regulatory compliance.
* Experience with budgeting, staffing, financial management, and quality improvement.
* Strong understanding of hospice operations, reimbursement, and interdisciplinary care.

### **Work Environment**

This is a full-time, in-person leadership position requiring occasional travel to:

* Hospice offices
* Patient homes
* Assisted living communities
* Skilled nursing facilities
* Hospitals and healthcare partner locations

### **Join Our Leadership Team!**

Are you ready to take your leadership career to the next level?

At Vitality Hospice & Palliative Care, you'll have the opportunity to lead talented teams, influence organizational success, and make a meaningful impact on the care we provide to patients and families.

**If you're an experienced hospice or healthcare operations leader who is passionate about developing teams, driving results, and making a difference, we want to hear from you!**

**Apply today and become part of a team where your leadership truly matters.**

**About All Points Broadband**

All Points Broadband is a fast-growing fiber internet provider on a mission to close the digital divide. We build and operate fiber networks that bring reliable, high-speed internet to underserved communities across Virginia and beyond, giving residents and businesses the connectivity they need to thrive.

  

We're a close-knit, fast-moving team headquartered in Richmond, VA. Everyone here has real ownership over their work and a direct hand in our growth. If you want a job where you can learn fast, take on real responsibility, and see the impact of your work in the communities we serve, you'll fit right in here.

  

**The Role**

  

Do you like talking to people and helping them make a good decision? As an Inside Sales Specialist at All Points Broadband, you'll be the first voice customers hear when they're ready to bring fiber internet home.

  

You'll take inbound calls, learn what each caller needs, and recommend the right plan. Some customers sign up on the first call. Others need time and a follow-up, and closing those is where good reps separate themselves. You'll get real training, a team behind you, and a product worth selling. Commission is uncapped, so the better you get, the more you earn.

  

**What You'll Do**

***Help customers find the right fit***

* Answer inbound calls and chats from people interested in our service.
* Ask questions to learn about what each customer needs, then recommend the plan that fits.
* Explain our plans, pricing, and availability in plain terms, so customers know exactly what they are getting.

  

***Close the sale and follow through***

* Handle objections with confidence, close the sale when the customer is ready, and follow up with those who need more time.
* Use our sales process and call scripts as your guide, from the first hello to sign-up.
* Log every call and sale accurately in our billing system, so nothing slips through the cracks.
* Work with our customer care and field sales teams so every new customer gets a smooth handoff.

  

***Keep getting better***

* Join regular coaching sessions and call reviews with your team and put the feedback to work.
* Stay current on our fiber services and how they compare to other internet providers.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* A high school diploma or equivalent.
* 1+ years in sales, a call center, or another customer-facing role. Preferred, not required.
* Experience handling objections and closing sales over the phone preferred.
* Experience working with or serving customers in rural communities preferred.
* A friendly, confident phone voice and the ability to build rapport quickly.
* Solid typing and grammar skills.
* Interest in sales and the drive to learn a full sales conversion, from first question to close. We'll train you.
* Comfort with computers and call center software, or the ability to pick them up quickly.
* Strong organization and follow-through on what you promise customers.

We believe in transparent and fair pay. The expected base pay range listed below for this position is based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, this position is eligible for commission.

  

Base Hourly Range: $18-$22

  

*We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, and retirement savings. Compensation decisions are made ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.*

Position Summary:

**Department**: Telecare
  
**Shift: Day / Full Time (M-F 8-4 Hybrid)**

**Location: Olrando**

**Title: RN, Telecare Nurse Triage**

**A Brief Overview**  
  
The Registered Nurse (RN) TeleCare Nurse Triage is responsible for handling high-volume after-hours patient care concerns and coordination using Evidence-Based Practice Standards. The Telecare Nurse Triage RN practices effective problem identification, resolution, and/or escalation while addressing urgent patient clinical inquiries for Orlando Health and non-Orlando Health patients. This position includes flexible work arrangement of work from home.  
  
**What you will do**

* Under the general supervision of the TeleCare shift supervisor, the RN will be responsible for after-hours patient triaging, outbound and inbound communication through phone calls, text, video, electronic messages, or digital communication assistant assisting with nurse case management, nursing assessments, collaboration with providers, and other departments providing quality patient care in compliance with local, state, and federal regulations.
* Applies nursing knowledge and critical thinking skills necessary to provide developmental, cultural, and age-appropriate evidence-based care.
* Accurately assesses each patient’s condition by actively listening to callers and asking probative questions.
* Recognizes a change in patient status directing them to the appropriate care setting including, but not limited to, emergency rooms (ERs), urgent care centers, home care advice, schedule patients to their physician during office hours, or communicate information to the physician on call as needed.

* Provides appropriate and courteous advice including plan of care and patient education to callers providing the highest level of quality care and customer service.
* Places outbound outreach follow-up calls, texts, or electronic messages to patients and caregivers as assigned for symptom management and care coordination.
* Appropriately and accurately documents initial and ongoing patient interactions, with documentation being completed immediately after the interaction.

* Refills prescriptions following Orlando Health policy and provider requirements.
* Assists with scheduling patients in a same day/next day appointment spot when indicated by disposition and level of care indicated.
* Meets unit expectations for call volumes, call duration, quality, safety, and customer service.
* Maintains reasonably regular, punctual attendance consistent with Orlando Health policies, the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state, and local standards.
* Maintains compliance with all Orlando Health policies and procedures.
* Performs all other duties as assigned
* Appropriately utilizes and maintains supplied equipment; troubleshoots tech issues to ensure uninterrupted service to patients.
* Serves as a clinical resource and professional role model for other nursing staff.
* Participates in medical chart reviews and compiles data for audits and reports.
* Participates in performance improvement activities as assigned.

* Performs all other duties as assigned.

Our people are passionate about what they do, the product they sell, and the customers they serve. If you're looking for an opportunity to be a part of a work family that values collaboration, innovation and dedication, we're the right company for you.

Qualifications:

* Must have a BSN; Graduate of an approved school of nursing.

Job Description

Momentum360 is seeking a creative, organized, and motivated **Marketing & Operations Assistant** to join our growing team!

This position is ideal for a recent college graduate or early-career professional who enjoys graphic design, photography, social media, and digital marketing while also having a passion for helping others.

At Momentum360, we work with individuals facing challenges related to behavioral health, housing instability, and access to community resources. Our goal is to connect individuals with meaningful support and opportunities to improve their overall well-being.

We're looking for someone who can bring fresh ideas, create engaging content, and help keep our daily operations running smoothly.

**This is a hybrid creative and administrative role, with approximately 60% of responsibilities focused on marketing and 40% focused on operational and program support.**

Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing & Creative Content (60%)

* Design engaging email newsletters and marketing campaigns using Mailchimp.
* Create professional flyers, social media graphics, event announcements, and promotional materials using Canva.
* Capture photos and short-form videos during community events and outreach activities, following organizational privacy guidelines.
* Edit photos and videos for social media, newsletters, and marketing campaigns.
* Assist with planning, creating, and scheduling social media content.
* Help develop creative strategies to increase community awareness and engagement.
* Maintain consistent branding across social media, email communications, and printed materials.
* Collaborate with leadership to promote organizational programs, partnerships, and events.

Operations & Program Support (40%)

* Assist with administrative documentation, progress note preparation, and organization of program records under appropriate supervision.
* Support data entry, spreadsheets, member tracking, and program reporting.
* Help coordinate community outreach events, meetings, and special projects.
* Assist with member communications and connecting individuals to available community resources.
* Maintain organized and accurate electronic records.
* Provide general administrative support to case managers and leadership.
* Assist with improving internal systems and day-to-day operational efficiency.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow organizational policies regarding sensitive member information.

Qualifications

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Sociology, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Human services-related education is strongly preferred.
* Strong interest in graphic design, digital content creation, and marketing.
* Basic photography and photo/video editing abilities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organization, time management, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Comfortable learning new technology and software platforms.
* Passion for supporting underserved individuals and communities.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with a team.

**Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)**

* Experience using Canva, Mailchimp, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.
* Experience creating social media content or managing social media accounts.
* Familiarity with photography, video editing, or digital marketing.
* Previous nonprofit, behavioral health, or human services experience.
* Experience with case management documentation or electronic health records.
* Experience planning or assisting with community events.

**Recent graduates are encouraged to apply!** Professional experience is not required if you can demonstrate creativity, strong organizational skills, and a willingness to learn.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique?

At Momentum360, you won't be limited to one department or spend every day performing the same tasks.

You'll have the opportunity to:

* **Build your creative portfolio** through real marketing campaigns, photography, and design projects.
* **Gain nonprofit and human services experience** while supporting meaningful community programs.
* **Work directly with leadership** and contribute ideas that help shape the organization's growth.
* **Develop transferable professional skills** in marketing, administration, operations, and community outreach.
* **Make a meaningful impact** by helping connect individuals with programs, services, and resources.

We value initiative, creativity, accountability, and individuals who are excited to grow professionally.

Who We're Looking For

Our ideal candidate is someone who enjoys being creative but is equally comfortable staying organized and handling administrative responsibilities.

You might be a great fit if you're a psychology graduate who loves graphic design, a marketing graduate passionate about community services, or someone with a human services background who enjoys photography and social media.

We're looking for a self-starter who takes pride in their work, pays attention to details, follows through on assignments, and brings a positive, solutions-oriented attitude to the team.

How to Apply

Please submit the following through Indeed:

* **An updated resume** highlighting your education, experience, and relevant skills.
* **Samples of your creative work**, such as Canva designs, flyers, social media graphics, photography, short videos, or email marketing campaigns.

**Academic projects, personal creative projects, and sample portfolios are welcome.** Professional marketing experience is not required.

Momentum360 is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds and experiences.

Pay: $19.30 - $21.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

**CONTEXT OF THE JOB:**

The University of Delaware’s business school, the Alfred Lerner College of Business and Economics, is a hub for innovation, business and economics research and career success. With hands-on experiences and a technology-driven curriculum, Lerner equips students to navigate the evolving business world and drive change worldwide.
  
  
Under the general supervision of the Senior Assistant Dean and the Director of Lerner Career Services, the Administrative Specialist oversees the administrative and fiscal operations supporting Lerner Undergraduate Advising, Lerner Career Services, and undergraduate recruitment activities. The Administrative Specialist monitors departmental budgets and expenditures; coordinates administrative processes, events, and front-desk operations; prepares enrollment and other administrative reports; manages departmental data and reporting systems; supervises support staff and student employees; coordinates web and communications activities; and serves as a liaison between the unit and the Lerner College Business Office and other University offices. The position is responsible for applying and interpreting University policies and procedures, assisting with policy development, analyzing administrative practices, and recommending improvements to enhance operational effectiveness and service delivery.

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage the day-to-day administrative and operational functions of the Lerner Undergraduate Advising and Lerner Career Services units and support undergraduate recruitment activities. Process requisitions, invoices, purchasing transactions, and other financial documents, including preparing and administering departmental purpose codes and budgets.
* Administer departmental purchasing card transactions.
* Monitor and review departmental expenditures for appropriate funding, reporting, and policy compliance.
* Ensure the accuracy and availability of funding and compliance with standard accounting and audit procedures.
* Ensure the smooth and effective operation of the unit’s administrative office and front-desk reception services.
* Assist the Senior Assistant Dean with confidential correspondence and sensitive student matters, including issues related to medical leaves, dismissals, and suspensions. Handle confidential information in accordance with university policies and applicable privacy requirements.
* Supervise non-exempt support staff, miscellaneous workers, graduate students, and student employees; hire, motivate, develop, direct, and assign work; monitor workload and productivity; evaluate performance; provide staff training and development; provide assistance in analyzing and resolving complex issues.
* Plan, coordinate, and conduct projects requiring judgment in the independent evaluation, selection, and substantial adaptation and modification of standard techniques.
* Work closely with the College events management team to plan and coordinate major undergraduate events. Coordinate First-Year Student Welcome Back, Honors Day, and undergraduate Convocation ceremonies. Assist with program production, logistics, and event-related communications. Provide occasional weekend support for Convocation, recruiting events, and other major University activities.
* Work with Lerner Marketing/Communication team to support mass communications to students and prospective students.

* Provide a high level of customer service to students, faculty, staff, alumni, prospective students and families, and employers both in person and by telephone.

1445694b1ad479d28a34.description:
**About Us**

At Ovation Law Firm, we’re more than just attorneys — we’re a source of hope and justice for consumers and injury victims. Our firm is dedicated to turning legal challenges into life-changing victories worldwide. We handle Lemon Law and Personal Injury cases with relentless commitment, standing up for our clients when it matters most.

We pride ourselves on being relentless advocates who never back down, ensuring that our clients' rights are fiercely protected. If you are passionate about making a meaningful difference and eager to contribute to our unwavering pursuit of justice, we invite you to join our dynamic team.

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Settlement Coordinator to join our remote team and support our mission of achieving meaningful outcomes for clients nationwide.

**About the Role**

  

The Settlement Coordinator moves lemon law cases from demand to funded settlement. You track every settlement, keep manufacturers and clients on schedule, and make sure settlement paperwork, vehicle surrenders and payments close cleanly.

We represent consumers in automotive lemon law claims against manufacturers nationwide. You will work closely with attorneys, case managers and manufacturer counsel on a high volume of active files.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Calculate repurchase and cash-and-keep figures, including incidental damages, offsets for use, negative equity and payoff amounts.
* Track every settlement, offer and counter-offer, and flag responses that fall below authorized ranges to the assigned attorney.
* Serve as day-to-day contact with manufacturer representatives and defense counsel on open settlements.
* Follow up on outstanding checks, vehicle surrenders, release drafts and funding timelines, and escalate files that stall past firm deadlines.
* Coordinate vehicle surrender logistics, including inspection dates, title transfer, lienholder payoff and payment of attorney's fees.
* Explain offers, settlement terms and next steps to clients in plain language.
* Obtain signed releases, settlement agreements, odometer statements and other required documents.
* Keep clients updated on surrender scheduling and payment status.
* Review release agreements for accuracy against the agreed terms before sending for signature.
* Track settlement checks and attorney fee payments through receipt and disbursement.
* Confirm lien and loan payoffs are completed and documented.
* Keep case management records current for every settlement milestone.

  

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years in a law firm, claims, or settlement role, preferably in consumer or plaintiff-side litigation.
* Experience reading and summarizing financial documents such as purchase contracts, lease agreements and loan payoff statements.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas for damages and offset calculations.
* Experience with a case management system (e.g., Filevine, Clio).
* Clear, professional written communication with clients and opposing counsel.
* Demonstrates strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and quality in all tasks and deliverables.

  

**What We Offer**

  

* Earn $22-24/hour: Pay based on your skills and experience for a full-time, 40-hour workweek.
* Boost Your Income: Enjoy performance-based bonuses.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance benefits.
* 7 Paid time off (PTO) days plus 7 paid holidays.
* Opportunity to directly influence the growth and success of a rapidly expanding law firm.
* Long-term growth opportunities within a fast-growing organization.

  

**Work Location**

This is a fully remote position open only to candidates residing in Florida.

**How to Apply**

  

Applying takes two short steps:

  

* Submit your application
* Complete our Culture Index survey (about 10 minutes): https://go.cultureindex.com/p/wV7Ib6RQQH2

*The survey is a short questionnaire about how you naturally like to work. There are no right or wrong answers, and we look at it alongside your experience, not instead of it. Please use the same name and email address on the survey that you use on this application so we can match them up.*

Job Description

**Part -Time Rolex Concierge – Job Description**

**Location: Christiana Mall, Delaware**

**Reports To:** Store Management

  

**Position:** Rolex Concierge

**Department:** Retail Rolex

**About Us:**

The 1916 Company is a premier luxury watch and fine jewelry retailer with showrooms and boutiques across the US, Collector's Lounges in major domestic and international markets, and four international offices - with 25 locations in total. We are committed to delivering exceptional client experiences and building teams of extraordinary individuals who share our passion for excellence and the world's finest timepieces and jewelry.

**Job Summary:**

The Concierge serves as the first point of contact for clients, setting the tone for an exceptional luxury shopping experience with The 1916 Company. This individual is responsible for creating a warm and welcoming environment, assisting with greeting and meeting the needs of clients, and providing seamless service throughout their visit. The Concierge will anticipate client expectations, coordinate personalized experiences, and support the sales team in delivering an elevated level of hospitality and exclusivity.

**Objectives:**

The objective of the Concierge is to deliver exceptional client support and foster lasting relationships. This role plays a critical part in enhancing overall customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Client Experience & Hospitality***

* Greeting clients warmly, offering personalized service from the moment they enter the store.
* Assisting in the management of foot traffic flow and matching clients with available advisors.
* Provide hospitality, including offering refreshments and ensuring client comfort.
* Maintain a polished, professional presence that reflects the store’s luxury standards.
* Assist in coordinating in-store experiences, private appointments, special deliveries, and special events.

***Client Support & Assistance***

* Facilitate smooth transitions between different touchpoints of the client’s journey in-store.
* Attending to the phone, answering calls, fielding questions, taking messages, and seeing that calls and messages are directed to the appropriate person.
* Provide basic product knowledge and brand information, directing inquiries to appropriate Client Advisors.
* Provide support in service, welcoming clients, taking information (when needed), offering pickups, and cleaning (given proper training).
* Assist with store tours and navigation, ensuring clients receive undivided attention and personalized service.
* Support in managing appointments, reservations, and client requests efficiently.

***Personalized Service & Relationship Building***

* Learn and remember Client IQ and preferences to contribute to a more tailored experience.
* Handle special client requests, such as securing a private viewing area or arranging gift wrapping and delivery services.

***Store Operations & Support***

* Maintain the appearance of the Rolex space, ensuring it is immaculate, inviting, and meets the Swiss Eye standards.
* Coordinate with the leadership and back-office teams to enhance client experience.
* Assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, registry updates, and appointment follow-up when needed.
* Restock refrigerators and other hospitality supplies throughout the store.
* Check appearance of spaces, cleaning up flowers, outside of cases, drink and hospitality areas, and giving attention to any other areas as needed.

  

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** Minimum 2-3 years in luxury retail, hospitality, or a client-facing role.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a polished and professional demeanor.
* **Client-Centric Mindset:** Passion for delivering personalized service and creating memorable experiences.
* **Problem-Solving:** Ability to anticipate and address client needs with discretion and efficiency.
* **Organization & Multitasking:** Strong ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of service.
* **Technology:** Proficiency in CRM systems, appointment scheduling tools, and basic office software.
* **Luxury Aesthetic:** Understanding of luxury brand culture, etiquette, and service expectations.

  

**Core Competencies**

* **Hospitality & Warmth:** Ability to make every client feel valued and welcome.
* **Attention to Detail:** Ensuring every aspect of the store environment and client experience is flawless.
* **Discretion & Professionalism:** Handling VIP and high-profile clients with the utmost confidentiality and care.
* **Team Collaboration:** Working seamlessly with Client Advisors, Managers, and support teams.
* **Adaptability:** Ability to adjust to dynamic client needs and in-store experiences.

**Performance Metrics**

* Client satisfaction, reviews, and mystery shop scores.
* Efficiency in managing appointments and store flow.
* Contribution to enhanced client relationships and repeat visits.
* Coordination and execution of special client experiences.

  

*The Concierge is an integral part of the luxury retail experience, ensuring each client interaction is seamless, elegant, and memorable. By embodying hospitality, discretion, and service excellence, this role enhances the prestige of the store and fosters deep client relationships.*

**POSITION TITLE:** Project Management Assistant

**LOCATION:** Remote

**CLEARANCE:** Must be able to obtain a Public Trust

  

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

  

At APV, we’re more than a technology company — we’re a mission-driven powerhouse transforming organizations through advanced technology and human ingenuity. Our expertise spans AI/ML, data architecture, low-code/no-code development, Agile DevSecOps, and cloud services, delivering scalable and meaningful solutions.

In our Emerging Technology Lab, innovation drives progress. Our teams create intelligent chatbots, AI-powered assistants, robotic process automation (RPA), essay graders, and data analytics platforms. If you’re passionate about solving complex challenges and shaping the future, APV is the place for you. Since 2007, we’ve partnered with federal and state agencies to deliver IT, training, and consulting solutions that achieve mission-critical outcomes. Built on accountability, integrity, and quality, we go beyond expectations. With 70+ prime contracts and a proven record of client success, APV continues to grow — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

  

**At APV, we Always Provide Value**

  

**POSITION SUMMARY**

  

Seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Project Management Assistant to provide administrative and coordination support to two or more Project Managers across APV's federal contracts. This role keeps project operations running smoothly — managing schedules, meetings, documentation, status reporting, and deliverable tracking — so Project Managers can stay focused on client delivery and team leadership. The ideal candidate is proactive, comfortable balancing competing priorities, and thrives in a fast-paced federal contracting environment.

  

**DUTIES**

  

* Provide day-to-day administrative support Project Managers, balancing competing priorities and deadlines across multiple contracts.
* Manage Project calendars; schedule internal and client meetings, coordinate attendees, and set up virtual or in-person meeting logistics.
* Prepare meeting agendas, capture meeting minutes and action items, and distribute finalized notes after management review.
* Coordinate daily stand-ups and weekly internal status meetings, and gather task status from project team members.
* Compile weekly status reports, briefing materials, and supporting data to prepare Project Managers for client status meetings.
* Track contract deliverables, milestones, and due dates; send reminders and follow up with team members to support on-time, accountable delivery.
* Maintain project schedules, action item logs, risk and issue logs, and trackers using tools such as Microsoft Project, Excel, SharePoint, or Smartsheet.
* Organize and maintain project files, document libraries, and version control in SharePoint/Teams in line with contract and APV records requirements.
* Format, proofread, and quality-check deliverables, reports, presentations, and correspondence before submission.
* Support onboarding logistics for new project team members, including system access requests, badging, and required client training, in partnership with HR and Operations.
* Assist with timesheet reminders, labor-hour tracking, invoice support data, and monthly status report preparation.
* Serve as a point of contact for routine project inquiries from team members and client staff, routing issues to the appropriate Project Manager.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

**EDUCATION**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Communications, or a related field preferred. An Associate's degree combined with relevant experience, or equivalent relevant experience, may be considered.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Minimum 2 years of experience providing administrative, project coordination, or program support, preferably in a government contracting or professional services environment.
* Demonstrated ability to support multiple managers and projects at the same time while meeting deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including meeting minutes, status reports, and professional correspondence with clients.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint).
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with sound judgment in handling sensitive and confidential information.

* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or equivalent federal client access. This role supports sensitive federal programs and involves elevated access to systems and data.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or active progress toward one.
* Experience supporting federal contracts (e.g., CMS, DHS, or other civilian agencies), including familiarity with contract deliverables and monthly status reporting.
* Experience with Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar project management tools.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum ceremonies and terminology.

  

**ABOUT APV**

  

APV is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or marital status.

**ESL Teacher for Adult Learners — Virtual, Remote**

*Teach motivated adult Russian-speaking professionals in the U.S. to build real-world English fluency.*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

You’ll teach live online 1:1, 1:2 and group English lessons via Zoom using professionally designed, ready-to-teach materials. Students are adult native Russian speakers living in the USA — motivated, driven, and enrolled in a structured year-long fluency program.

**ABOUT ME**

I’m an ESL educator and former school teacher with a Master’s degree in Curriculum & Instruction and 4 years of experience in American public schools as a reading specialist and special education coordinator. I created Fluency Gym — a cohort-based adult English fluency program — initially as a small side project. It’s grown beyond what I can teach alone, and I’m looking for the right person to grow with me.

**WHY THIS POSITION IS OPEN**

Demand for Fluency Gym has grown faster than my capacity. I need a skilled, reliable teacher to take on cohorts so students don’t have to wait. You’ll be stepping into a program that already works — your job is to deliver it well.

**WHAT I OFFER**

* Flexible scheduling — you choose the hours that work for you
* Complete, professionally prepared lesson materials — no lesson planning from scratch required
* Hands-on onboarding and ongoing training
* Regular feedback delivered in a supportive, collaborative way
* A clear, structured program to teach — no guesswork

**LONG-TERM GROWTH**

This is not just a teaching gig — it’s the start of something bigger. As Fluency Gym grows, I’m looking for my first teacher to grow with it — taking on more cohorts, eventually moving into a lead teacher or supervisor role, and helping onboard and mentor new teachers. If you’re someone who wants to build something meaningful, not just teach classes, this is for you.

**COMPENSATION**

Earn **$18-22/hr** based on performance. Base pay is guaranteed, with additional performance bonuses on top. No lesson planning means your paid hours are focused on what matters: teaching and supporting your students.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Deliver live 1:1, 1:2 and group lessons via Zoom following provided lesson materials
* Create a warm, engaging, and productive classroom environment
* Manage group dynamics to ensure balanced participation (not dominated by a few students)
* Track student attendance and progress
* Provide students with clear, encouraging, and actionable feedback on their language use and progress
* Communicate with me regularly about student performance and group dynamics
* Implement feedback from lesson observations

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Students show measurable improvement in fluency and confidence
* Students complete the program and re-enroll or refer others
* Lessons run smoothly and on schedule with high engagement
* You grow as a teacher through consistent feedback and professional development

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Required**

* Excellent English language skills
* Zoom and Google Drive proficiency
* Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional teaching environment
* Experience teaching adults (1+ years)
* Online teaching experience (1+ years)

**Preferred**

* Teaching groups online (4+ students)
* TEFL/TESOL certificate
* Background in ESL, linguistics, or education
* Familiarity with Russian-speaking culture

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

You’re genuinely excited about your students’ progress. You’re growth-minded — you actively seek feedback, take it seriously, and implement it. You’re organized, show up on time, and communicate proactively. You understand that teaching from provided materials is a skill in itself and you bring your own energy and warmth to every lesson.

Ideally, you’re thinking long-term: you want to grow inside a program. You’re interested in eventually taking on more responsibility — mentoring other teachers, maintaining quality standards, and being part of building something.

**THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF YOU…**

* Are not comfortable teaching diverse groups, including both Russian and Ukrainian students
* Prefer to design your own curriculum and resist working from prepared materials
* See feedback as criticism rather than professional development
* Are looking for a short-term contract with no interest in growing with the program

**TO APPLY**

**Please include the following in your application:**

* A short video (2–3 min) introducing yourself and briefly explaining how you would handle a quiet, unresponsive group
* Your available hours (days and time zones)

Pay: $18.00 - $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
