502847d1db1428e81202.title: Protocol Specialist
502847d1db1428e81202.description:
Overview:

Medical Solutions, a leader in the medical staffing industry, is looking for a highly motivated individual who is well versed in healthcare staffing, compliance, and process management for the position of Protocol Specialist, as part of the Quality Team.  
  
The Protocol Specialist will have a placement and/or sales background and will serve as a resource for questions relating to protocol and compliance. This person will update all compliance protocol in internal technology systems to maintain current including adding new clients. The candidate will be responsible for communication with hospitals as directed by Client Manager and/or Managed Service Provider (MSP) Coordinator for the MSP account. The candidate will work with multiple departments to assist with project implementation and integration.

Responsibilities:

* Review contracts to extract protocol
* Build protocol into current tracking system
* Communicates with Client Management group, Onboarding Specialists, MSP Implementation Specialists and Vendor Relations Manager to ensure updated protocol
* Review all protocol updates to ensure communicated to all appropriate team members
* Compile and track flu season as needed
* Build and manage documents in PandaDoc, assist with sending out documents for signature
* Work with sales team to ensure correct hierarchy is set up in Pulse and 2.0
* Create and updated email templates and checklists for MSP division
* Serve as expert for the Client Portal for document management on Placement side
* Work with IT and other departments to test and roll out new protocol technology
* Serve as Champion for project implementation for those projects which relate with protocol
* Work closely with sales teams and management
* Ability to manage a high desk level at a very fast pace

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* Previous employment in healthcare staffing setting preferred
* Strong team player and ability to work with others within and outside of team
* Strong computer skills
* Ability to provide feedback for projects
* Ability to multi-task
* Great organizational skills
* Close attention to detail
* Able to meet deadlines
* Able to manage a large and increasing workload
* Excellent communication and grammatical skills
* Ability to see entire picture of contract
* Take ownership of getting the job done
* Positive attitude and friendly demeanor
* Must be highly computer literate, including strong skills in Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel

Pay Range: USD $21.50 - USD $26.50 /Hr.

533afe405e27c8cb9720.title: Medical Assistant
533afe405e27c8cb9720.description:
**Description**

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.  
  
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?  
  
**Entity: Clinical Care Associates (CCA) - Penn Primary Care (PPC) and Penn Specialty Practices (PSP) of Penn Medicine Medical Group (PMMG)**  
**Department: PPC and Integrative Med Whtlnd**  
**Location: Penn Primary Care & Integrative Medicine- 724 W Lincoln Hwy**  
**Hours: Per Departmental Needs – Full Time**  
Job Summary:

* The Medical Assistant (MA) assists the practice manager and physicians in maintaining a patient/customer focus, supports the delivery of high-quality care, shares a passion for patient and customer centered care, and assists in meeting or exceeding patient satisfaction and financial/operational targets. The MA provides patient care through performance of patient preparation, interviewing, technical tasks, and patient/family communication.
* Are you looking for an organization that actively supports your career growth? If so, a Medical Assistant opportunity at Penn Medicine can help get you there! Medical Assistants have an opportunity to join our organization and make a difference in the lives of our patients. Medical Assistants with Penn Medicine are in a unique position to gain valuable knowledge which can be leveraged to move not only into more advanced clinical roles but also operational roles. Through our generous tuition benefit as well as our commitment to promoting from within Penn Medicine sees more than 30% of our employees secure advancement opportunities into roles such as a Clinical Services Coordinator, Nurses, and Practice Managers just to name a few!
* Penn Medicine employees enjoy a comprehensive benefit package to include generous paid time off and paid holidays. And health insurance premiums which have remained flat for 5 years!
* Want to hear more? Submit your application today for this Medical Assistant opportunity and learn more about what a career path at Penn Medicine could look like for you!

  
Responsibilities:

* Patient Care Accountabilities
* Promptly rooms patients, using EMR to alert provider that patient is ready: reviews past medical, surgical, family, smoking history, allergies, medications; notes corrections in EMR, notes medication refills needed for the physician to review, initiates self-management goal setting where appropriate, obtains patient’s vital signs and documents in EMR, prepares chart for patient visit, understands insurance restrictions for lab work, referral needs, precertification requirements, etc.
* Observes patient condition and communicates any abnormal data or changes to provider.
* Assists patients as needed with walking, transfers, dressing, undressing, preparing for the exam, remains in exam room when necessary/requested.
* Specimen management: obtain specimens for testing if applicable (including performing phlebotomy and anterior nares nasal swab collections), performs laboratory and screening tests, records results in EMR and reconciles with logs where appropriate, documents and reports findings to providers, performs all quality controls as per Point of Care Testing guidelines, prepares specimens for transport as necessary.
* Performs EKGs and other outpatient screening tests as per MD order and after properly preparing the patient; accurately documents results in EMR.
* Assists with minor surgical procedures by handing instruments, maintaining sterile field, positioning of patient and other duties within scope of responsibility. Functions as a witness for procedural consents if required.
* Responds appropriately to emergency/code situations.
* Demonstrates competence in the observation, treatment, and care of the specific patients served in that practice, whose ages may range from neonate to geriatric.
* Clinical Care Associates (CCA) MAs - if applicable as per regulatory guidelines: administers prescribed medications, gives injections and vaccines; reads PPD results, under the direction of the provider/orders and documents in EMR.
* Clerical / Other Accountabilities
* Responsive and proactive telephonic patient care - including care coordination with specialists, ancillary services, hospitals, labs, home care agencies, and all other involved health services.
* Obtain and scan documents as appropriate and required for visit: test results, faxes, reports, notes, referrals, etc.
* Completes medical forms and other clinical requests for information as appropriate and required. Prepares and sends patient correspondence as required. Assists nursing staff with the maintenance of patient education materials, as needed.
* Clinical Care Associates (CCA) MAs: Promptly performs call-backs as directed by provider, giving patients information within their scope of practice. Provides patients with follow up care instructions.
* Environmental / Safety Accountabilities
* Adheres to universal body fluids precautions and infection control policies. Disposes of infectious waste properly. Promotes infection control by using appropriate hand washing techniques.
* Ensures that the patient care areas are kept neat, orderly, well stocked and properly prepared.
* Cleans, disinfects, and sterilizes instruments and equipment according to protocols and checks that the instruments and equipment are in proper working order. Notifies Supervisor of malfunctions. Sets up equipment and instruments as per practice protocol.
* Cleans and restocks equipment as needed. Authorized to access secured area to obtain items such as intravenous solutions and medication preparation supplies for the purpose of stocking and maintaining pars in the medication carts. Retrieves supplies and medications/blood products from tube system. Secures stock items in appropriate location. Delivers patient specific medications/blood products to the assigned nurse or provider.
* Maintain temperature log for refrigerator or room temperature as needed.
* Maintains a safe environment and protects the patient from injury by observing the patient who may be at risk for falls, confusion, disorientation, or wandering behaviors.
* Clinical Care Associates (CCA) MAs - if applicable as per regulatory guidelines: Maintains medication storage closet inventory and security; checks expiration dates; removes outdated items. Performs daily code/crash cart checks as assigned.
* Other / Regulatory
* Ensures compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulatory standards (ex TJC, DOH, FDA, HIPAA, HCFA, DPW, LCGME, SCGME, etc)
* Flexible and readily adopts new processes and engages in practice operation changes.
* Performs duties in accordance with Penn Medicine and entity values, policies, and procedures
* Other duties as assigned to support the unit, department, entity, and health system organization

  
Credentials:

* BLS/CPR, as a healthcare provider as per the American Heart Association (Required)
* MA Certification (required within 90 days of hire) (Required)

  
Education or Equivalent Experience:

* H.S. Diploma/GED (Required)
* Completion of an accredited Medical Assistant program (or higher level equivalent). Or 18+ months Experience working as an MA may be considered in lieu of MA program completion. Or 1+ year working as a Clinical Support Representative at Penn Medicine may be considered in lieu of MA program completion (Required)
* 1+ years Related experience (Preferred)

  
We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives.  
  
Live Your Life's Work

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status, citizenship status, military status, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable law.

100477074dba7cbf132a.title: CDOC Mental Health Community Liaison - Colo Spgs: Hybrid/Remote and travel to facilities as needed
100477074dba7cbf132a.description:
**Department Information**
--------------------------

If your goal is to build a career that makes a difference and builds greater public confidence in good government, consider joining the dedicated people of the State of Colorado. Our professionals strive to support state government and the citizens of Colorado. Customer service is a key component for every position in state government as is the focus on ideas and ways to redesign the delivery of services in making state government more effective and efficient.

  
  

In addition to a great agency and rewarding, meaningful work, we offer:

* Distinctive career advancement opportunities throughout the state system;
* Strong, secure, yet flexible retirement benefits including PERA Defined Benefit Plan or PERA Defined;
* Contribution Plan plus 401K and 457 plans. Member Contribution Rates. Correctional Officers I-IV qualify as "Safety Officers" and are eligible for increased PERA benefits;
* Medical and dental health plans;
* Short and long term disability coverage;
* Paid life insurance;
* 11 paid holidays per year plus vacation and sick leave;
* Wellness program, tuition reimbursement, training opportunities and more;
* Visit State of Colorado Employee Benefits. for more information;
* This position is compensated on a bi-weekly pay cycle.

  

**Who May Apply:**

This position is only open to Colorado state residents.

  
  

**Job Location:**

Colorado Department of Corrections Headquarters

The resulting eligibility list may be used to fill future vacancies at this location

**Description of Job**
----------------------

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Builds relationships with behavioral health departments from outside agencies to support appropriate information sharing and improved continuity of care for the offender population.
* Obtains ROIs and gathers records/data regarding individual CDOC clients as needed.
* Performs daily functions related to the release and management of protected health information (PHI) in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Colorado Revised Statutes, and Department of Corrections (DOC) policies and procedures. Determines the validity and completeness of requests for release of confidential healthcare information and processes approved requests in accordance with established regulations and guidelines.
* Copies, distributes, and tracks the release of behavioral health records.
* Requests clinical information and records from outside agencies, county jails, out of state DOC’s, and community behavioral health providers as needed.
* Scans documents and behavioral health records into the electronic health record (EHR) system. Maintains tracking systems for all requested and released protected health information.
* Will focus on gathering and sharing behavioral health records in accordance with established rules and regulations identified in CDOC policy.
* Will serve as clinical administrative support to multidisciplinary staff.
* Provide support to the CDOC Diagnostic Unit, CDOC Psychologist team, Behavioral Health Program Managers, and CDOC facilities on the request of behavioral health records from outside agencies, community behavioral health providers, regional county jails, out-of-state agencies.
* Other administrative duties as assigned such as gathering/tracking of offender data to support continuity of care between CDOC facilities, completion of offender intake documentation and release of information forms.

**Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment & Appeal Rights**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Residency Requirement:**

This posting is only open to residents of the State of Colorado at the time of submitting your application.  
  
  

**Class Code & Classification Description:**

C4L1TX Social Work/Counselor I
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications:**
  
Applicant must possess a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in one of the following mental health fields: counseling, social work, psychology, or marriage and family therapy. You must attach a copy of your transcripts that contain your name, name of the accredited institution, type of degree received and date degree was conferred.
  
  
Ensure that the “Work Experience" section of the application is complete and contains all relevant work experience related to the position that you are applying for. This information will be used to help determine compensation for the position. "See resume" statements cannot be accepted in lieu of the "work experience" section of the application. Additional work experience will not be accepted after the job announcement close date for compensation purposes.  
  
**Substitutions:**
  
Related experience in behavioral health services will substitute for the degree requirement on a year-for-year basis. **W****ork experience less than full time will be prorated.**
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience managing confidential information or records.
* Experience creating and implementing trackers and other organizational tools.
* Experience responding to time sensitive requests, as well as strong overall time management skills.
* Experience utilizing Google Suite Applications (i.e. google docs, google sheets, etc.) and electronic health records.
  

  

**Required Competencies:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
* Excellent computer skills;
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across facility programs and with external agencies;
* Ability to work independently under supervision;
* Ability to work with a diverse population of clients;
* Ability to provide mental health support services as part of a multi-disciplinary team;
* Ability to read and comprehend the English language;
* Ability to create accessible documents and technical content that follows plain language guidelines with accessibility in mind;
* Ability to effectively communicate fluently in English both verbally and in writing;
* Self-control, a strong sense of ability to work in stressful, potentially violent situations;
* Ability to remain alert, emotionally stable, and mentally resilient under pressure and observant throughout their shift;
* Tolerance to stress, confinement, and high-stakes interaction.
  

  

**IMPORTANT INFORMATION**

  

**The Assessment Process**: Your application will be reviewed to determine if you meet the minimum Qualifications (MQ's). Applicants that meet MQ’s will be included in the Comparative Analysis process. Colorado Revised Statutes require that state employees are hired and promoted through a comparative analysis which may include, but is not limited to, a suitability screening, Online Assessment, oral assessment, written performance assessment or it may include a review of your application material and your responses to any supplemental questions by a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to assess and rank applicants in order to establish an eligible list for referral to the hiring manager for final consideration.

Be sure the “Work Experience” section of your application is complete and specifically addresses your qualifications, experience, and accomplishments as they relate to the **Description of the Job**, **Minimum Qualifications**, **Required Competencies** and **Preferred Qualifications** as listed above. Resumes and “see resume” statements will not be accepted in lieu of the “Work Experience” section of the application. Failure to include adequate information or follow instructions by the closing date may result in your application not being accepted and/or may affect your score, rank or inclusion in the final pool of eligible applicants.

  
  

Employees who are rehired or reinstated within six months of their separation will return at either their previous pay rate if hired into the same class level or based on their time in the class series, whichever is higher. Those rehired or reinstated after six months' separation will be calculated using the same formula for new hires and promotions.

  
  

Please note that while this change in role may constitute a change in title and/or responsibility, salary adjustments are not guaranteed and may be influenced by factors such as internal pay equity, budget constraints, market benchmarks, or the individual’s current compensation level. Any changes to compensation will be determined separately and communicated accordingly.

  
  

If you have transcripts, a license or other relevant documentation regarding your qualifications, upload and attach copies to your application.

  
  

If an unofficial copy of transcripts is being submitted at the time of application, transcripts from colleges or universities outside the United States must be assessed for U.S. equivalency by a NACES educational credential evaluation service. This documentation is the responsibility of the applicant and must be included as part of your application materials. Failure to provide a transcript or credential evaluation report may prevent your application from moving forward in the selection process.

  
  

Under the Job Application Fairness Act (SB 23-058), applicants may redact information from certifications and transcripts that identify their age, date of birth or dates of attendance from an educational institution.

  
  

***In order to process a background investigation, your application must include at least (10) ten years of the most current work experience unless experience related to the job for which you are applying is later than (10) years. Failure to provide this information could result in delays and/or elimination from the background investigation process.***

  

**Toll Free Applicant Technical Support:** If you experience technical difficulty with the NEOGOV system (e.g. uploading or attaching documents to your online application) call NEOGOV technical support at 855-524-5627 Mon-Fri between 6 am and 6 pm (Pacific Time). Helpful hints: if you are having difficulty uploading or attaching documents to your application first, ensure your documents are PDF or Microsoft Word files and second, close the document before you attempt to upload (attach) it.

  
  

\*\*You are encouraged to print a copy of this announcement for your records\*\*

  
  

**Conditions of Employment:** All job offers are contingent upon a successful medical screening by a healthcare professional, certifying the candidate's ability to perform the essential functions of the position. Applicant must consent to hold harmless CDOC and its agents and staff from any liability arising in whole or in part from the testing and the use of this information in connection with CDOC’s consideration of application for employment.

  
  

* Must be 21 years of age
* Possess a valid driver’s license. Drivers must maintain a valid, non-restricted Colorado driver’s license, obey traffic laws, and be able to safely operate a motor vehicle. State drivers are expected to maintain a safe driving record consistent with Colorado Division of Human Resources Universal Policy Driving Standards. Eligibility to drive a State-owned vehicle, includes holding a valid Colorado driver’s license within 30 days of employment or residency change and meeting specific driving record criteria. Serious traffic violations, including DUIs or reckless driving, can disqualify drivers for up to seven years. All State Vehicles are monitored by telematics for safe operation and employees have no reasonable expectation of privacy while using an agency State Fleet vehicle.

* Possess a high school diploma or GED
* Former State employees who were disciplinarily terminated or resigned in lieu of termination are required to:

  + Disclose the details of the prior termination or resignation on the application.
  + Explain why the circumstances of the prior separation should not disqualify them from the current position.
  + Provide your employee number from your prior State employment. Absent extraordinary circumstances, prior disciplinary termination or resignation in lieu of termination and failure to provide this information will disqualify the applicant from future State employment with CDOC.
* Have NO felony convictions, to include any actions defined in 5 U.S.C. 301; U.S.C. 509, 510; 42 U.S.C. 15601-15609. The CDOC shall not hire nor promote anyone who may have contact with an offender who has engaged in sexual abuse which includes acts, activity, and sexual behavior, in a prison or other institution as defined in 42 U.S.C. 1997; or has been convicted of engaging or attempting to engage in sexual activity in the community facilitated by force, overt or implied threats of force or coercion, or if the victim did not consent or was unable to consent or refuse, or has been civilly or administratively adjudicated to have engaged in the activity described in the above paragraph. The agency shall consider any incidents of sexual harassment in determining whether to hire anyone who may have contact with offenders or residents.
* Applicants must have valid U.S. work authorization at the time of application; DOC cannot provide H-1B sponsorship at this time.
* Successfully pass all modules of the six-week Colorado Department of Corrections Basic Training, to include English reading comprehension, relevant competency assessments and written/practical exams in Defensive Tactics.
* Possess the physical ability to successfully complete Defensive Tactics

  + Lift arms above head and kick as high as own waist
  + Stabilize another person to accomplish a controlled take down
  + Use arms, palms of hands, shins, and feet to deliver blows
  + Withstand impact (slow speed or with a safety bag) on own body from strikes/blows
  + Swing a baton in a striking technique
  + Rotate body 90 degrees with feet planted for striking with foot or using a defensive tactic;
  + Get down on one or both knees and up again with multiple repetitions
* Will be exposed to Oleoresin Capsicum during Basic Training and will be exposed while on assignment
* Must be able to see and hear in order to observe, address and respond to potential breaches in safety and security
* Seize, hold, control or subdue violent or assaultive persons and defend oneself or others to prevent injury
* Demonstrate body agility, strength of all four limbs and the ability to walk and climb stairs consistently
* Work in situations involving assaultive behavior, physical control of another person and/or restraint situations
* Deal with individuals with a range of moods and behaviors, utilizing tactfulness and a congenial, personable manner
* Work with people of the opposite sex, diverse racial ethnic groups, mentally ill and emotionally disturbed offenders
* Communicate by talking, listening and/or signaling people to convey or exchange information, assignments
* Work in an environment with fluctuating noise and temperature (hot and cold) which may include working outdoors in inclement weather and/or concrete floor/wall work settings
* Willing and able to travel
* Willing and able to work various shifts, days, afternoons, graveyards (nights) which includes a rotating shift schedule
* TB (tuberculosis) screening is required of all new employees upon hire

  

Successful completion of a background investigation is required. Should applicant’s background reveal criminal charges, it shall be the responsibility of the applicant to provide the Department of Corrections with written/official disposition of any charges.

  
  

The CDOC is committed to a work environment free from illegal drugs and alcohol. Employees (see exception below) may use marijuana in their personal time but are prohibited from working while under the influence of any substance, including marijuana. A drug test will be administered to all new employees; employees must successfully pass. Random drug screening will occur throughout employment.

Exception: Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) certified employees are prohibited from the use of marijuana. Health care professionals must check their licensing requirements regarding marijuana use.

**Appeal Rights:**

  
  

As an applicant who has been removed from consideration during the selection or comparative analysis process, you may file an appeal with the State Personnel Board and/or request a review by the State Personnel Director. A standard appeal form is available on the State Personnel Board website, https://spb.colorado.gov/forms-and-filing. If you appeal, your appeal must be submitted in writing on the official appeal form, signed by you or your representative, and received at the following address within ten (10) days of your receipt of this notice: Colorado State Personnel Board/State Personnel Director, Attn: Appeals Processing, 1525 Sherman Street, 4th Floor, Denver, CO 80203. Fax: 303-866-5038. Phone: 303-866-3300. Email address: dpa\_state.personnelboard@state.co.us. The ten-day deadline and these appeal procedures also apply to all charges of discrimination. Refer to Chapters 4 and 8 of the State Personnel Board Rules and Personnel Director's Administrative Procedures, 4 CCR 801, for information about the appeals process. The State Personnel Board Rules and Personnel Director's Administrative Procedures are available at spb.colorado.gov.

**Supplemental Information**
----------------------------

After submitting an application, you should receive an email acknowledging your submission. If you do not get the email, please check to ensure you have actually submitted the application and typed the correct email address on the application.

  
  

Include a working email address on your application; one that is checked daily as time sensitive correspondence WILL take place via email. You may receive email notifications from a Colorado Dept. of Corrections employee or from this email address: info@governmentjobs.com. It is your responsibility to ensure that your email will accept these notices and/or review your junk mail and spam filtered email; if you do not receive correspondence soon after the closing date or if you have questions about this job announcement, please contact Kaylie Purcell, at kaylie.purcell@doc.state.co.

  
  

SCHEDULED DATES OF POSSIBLE APPLICANT ASSESSMENTS (I.E., EXAMS, ORAL BOARDS, WRITTEN EXAMS) WILL NOT BE MADE UP. IF YOU FAIL TO SHOW AT THE APPOINTED DATE/TIME, MAKE-UPS WILL NOT BE ALLOWED.

  
  

The State of Colorado believes that equity, diversity, and inclusion drive our success, and we encourage candidates from all identities, backgrounds, and abilities to apply. The State of Colorado is an equal opportunity employer committed to building inclusive, innovative work environments with employees who reflect our communities and enthusiastically serve them. Therefore, in all aspects of the employment process, we provide employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, medical condition related to pregnancy, creed, ancestry, national origin, marital status, genetic information, or military status (with preference given to military veterans), or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. The State of Colorado strives to create a Colorado for All by building and maintaining workplaces that value and respect all Coloradans through a commitment to equal opportunity and hiring based on merit and fitness. The State is resolute in non-discriminatory practices in everything we do, including hiring, employment, and advancement opportunities.

  
  

The Colorado Department of Corrections is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, our agency will assist individuals who have a disability with any reasonable accommodation requests related to employment, including completing the application process, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, participating in the employee selection process, and/or to perform essential job functions where the requested accommodation does not impose an undue hardship. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation to ensure you have a positive experience applying or interviewing for this position, please direct your inquiries to our Employee Relations Specialist, Kristen Lange, at doc\_employeerelations@state.co.us or call 719-728-0270.

  
  

ALL DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTIONS FACILITIES AND BUILDINGS ARE TOBACCO FREE.

WE STRONGLY ENCOURAGE PROTECTED CLASSES TO APPLY.

b19addecc29a41318225.title: Manager, Regulatory Compliance
b19addecc29a41318225.description:
Overview:

**Overview:**

HealthEdge is seeking a Manager, Regulatory Compliance to lead a team of regulatory professionals supporting HealthEdge Source™, HealthEdge’s reference data and pricing transparency platform. The Manager, Regulatory Compliance will lead a team of regulatory professionals responsible for monitoring, interpreting, and operationalizing federal and state regulatory requirements to align our products with regulatory changes impacting commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid lines of business. The Manager will coach, develop, and lead a team of claims pricing and editing subject matter experts, ensuring high-quality regulatory outputs, strong team engagement, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is a proven people manager who brings healthcare regulatory or reference data knowledge sufficient to guide the team’s work – someone who leads through others, builds capability, and creates accountability structures that allow the team to deliver consistently against a complex and evolving regulatory landscape.

**Your Impact**

As the Manager, Regulatory Compliance for HealthEdge Source™, you will:

  

* Build and sustain a high-performing team of regulatory and reference data SMEs through active coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing feedback.
* Manage workload distribution, prioritization, and delivery across the team to meet regulatory milestones and Source product release commitments.
* Serve as an escalation point for Source-related regulatory issues, guiding the team through complex interpretation and resolution.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Client Success stakeholders to ensure regulatory requirements are clearly understood and operationalized in Source.

**What you will do:**

**People Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, supervise, and develop a team of regulatory compliance professionals with expertise in claims pricing, reference data, and healthcare transparency requirements.
* Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and career development conversations.
* Build a team culture grounded in accountability, intellectual rigor, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Manage workload planning, capacity, and coverage to ensure consistent delivery against regulatory timelines and data release cycles.
* Drive onboarding and skill development for new and existing team members as Source’s regulatory scope evolves.

**Source Regulatory Operations**

* Oversee the team’s monitoring, interpretation, and documentation of federal and state regulatory requirements impacting pricing, reference data and editing.
* Ensure regulatory deliverables - system requirement specifications, and client-facing materials – are accurate, timely, and meet quality standards.
* Manage the team’s review and disposition of regulatory changes relevant to Source across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid lines of business.
* Oversee escalation management and resolution of complex regulatory issues affecting Source customers or product functionality.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with Source Product and Engineering to ensure regulatory requirements are incorporated into roadmap planning and sprint execution.
* Collaborate with Client Success and Implementation teams to support health plan client inquiries related to Source regulatory content.
* Represent the team’s work in cross-functional meetings, regulatory forums, and client-facing engagements as needed.
* Coordinate on enterprise regulatory monitoring and cross-product impact assessments where Source data intersects with other HealthEdge platforms.

**What you bring:**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 8+ years of experience in healthcare regulatory compliance, healthcare operations, managed care, or a related field.
* 5+ years of progressive people leadership experience, including leading teams of highly specialized professionals.
* Demonstrated success building team capability, managing performance, and developing staff in a technical or compliance environment.
* Experience working within or in support of a healthcare technology or managed care organization.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Working knowledge of claims pricing, editing and reference data concepts
* Familiarity with Transparency in Coverage requirements, including MRF obligations, schema versioning, and in-network/out-of-network file content standards.
* Ability to translate regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for team members and cross-functional partners.
* Exceptional people management skills: coaching, feedback, performance management, and team building.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills; comfortable managing multiple workstreams and release deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to summarize complex regulatory content for varied audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**About**
---------

***This role is remote from anywhere in the US.***

  
  

For over 25 years, NEOGOV has been at the forefront of public-sector innovation, building technology that helps government and education organizations work smarter, move faster, and better serve their communities.

We are a team of cutting-edge technologists, operators, and problem-solvers with top-tier skills and a shared ambition: to build the most efficient operating model in GovTech. We combine deep public-sector expertise with modern SaaS practices, AI-enabled workflows, and a relentless focus on execution.

  
  

At our core, we are a people-first company. We empower our customers to support the public servants they employ, the communities they serve, and the talented teams that bring our platform to life.

Our solutions support the entire employee journey, from hire to retire. By transforming complex HR and compliance workflows into simple, intuitive experiences, we help public-sector organizations reduce friction, improve efficiency, and focus on what matters most: making a difference.

  
  

*This posting is for an existing vacancy.*

  
  
As the Senior Manager, Billing & Accounts Receivable, you will own NEOGOV’s Order to Cash operations end to end, from accurate, on-time invoicing through collections and customer inquiries. Reporting directly to the VP Corporate Controller, you will lead a team of 10, including a Billing Manager and the accounts receivable team. You will set and track the KPIs that measure our performance and build the processes, controls and automation that make billing and collections accurate, timely and scalable. This is a hands-on role for an operator who follows through and delivers results.

**What You Will do**
--------------------

* **Lead Billing and Accounts Receivable Operations:** Own the end-to-end billing process through the Billing Manager, ensuring invoices are accurate and on time. Directly lead the collections team and ensure we meet SLAs on customer responses.
* **Own Collections Performance:** Manage DSO, AR aging, past-due balances and collection rates. Partner with the Billing Manager on credit memos and rebills with appropriate review and approval.
* **Build an Account-Ownership Model:** Structure the collections team so each specialist owns a portfolio of customers end to end, including outbound collections and inbound customer inquiries, with clear routing, backup coverage and response-time SLAs.
* **Own and Report KPIs:** Track and report weekly and monthly on key metrics, including DSO, past-due percentage, collection effectiveness, invoice accuracy, on-time billing and inquiry response times. Present trends, root causes and improvement plans to the VP Corporate Controller and senior leadership.
* **Lead and Develop the Team:** Lead and mentor a team of 10 billing and accounts receivable professionals, including the Billing Manager. Set clear goals, track performance against KPIs, conduct performance reviews, and provide the training and documented procedures the team needs to work accurately and consistently.
* **Improve Processes, Controls and Systems:** Document and standardize billing and collections processes, build quality-review steps that catch errors before they reach customers, and identify opportunities for AI and automation. Design and maintain SOX-compliant controls across Order to Cash.
* **Build Strong Cross-Functional Partnerships:** Work closely with Sales, Renewals, Customer Success and Legal to resolve billing discrepancies, answer customer inquiries and improve customer satisfaction. Build trusted relationships so issues are resolved quickly and at the right level.
* **Resolve Complex Issues:** Work with the Billing Manager and Sales leadership on complex billing and contracting issues.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **A Hands-On Operator:** You stay close to the work. You know what is happening in billing and collections day to day, follow through on commitments without reminders, and balance process improvement and SOX control design with running daily operations.
* **A Proven Team Builder:** You coach and develop people, set clear expectations and KPIs, hold the team accountable, and build high-performing finance teams.
* **A Cross-Functional Partner:** You build trust with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, Renewals and executive leadership. You translate billing and contracting requirements clearly and resolve issues quickly, protecting both cash collection and the customer experience.
* **A Process & Systems Builder:** You have a track record of documenting processes, driving system implementations and automation, and making continuous improvements in fast-paced software environments.
* **Data-Driven & Detail-Oriented:** You track the metrics that matter, including DSO, AR aging and accuracy rates, spot problems early, and turn data into clear recommendations for leadership.
  

  

**What You Have**

* 8+ years of experience in billing and accounts receivable, including Order to Cash operations at a software or SaaS company.
* 5+ years of people management experience, with a track record of building high-performing teams.
* Hands-on collections experience, including managing DSO, AR aging, disputes, payment plans and credit decisions.
* Experience managing a ticketing queue and tracking SLAs. Salesforce preferred.
* Working knowledge of revenue and accounts receivable accounting, including account reconciliations, the allowance for doubtful accounts and month-end close support.
* Strong systems experience. Knowledge of Salesforce Billing and NetSuite preferred.
* Experience designing and operating SOX-compliant controls.

**What NEOGOV Offers**
----------------------

* Comprehensive Benefits package (medical, dental, vision, etc.) for full-time employees
* Generous PTO to support work-life balance
* Remote working opportunities
* 401K Matching
* Autonomy to grow and find your career path with supportive leadership
* 12-week Paid Parental Leave
* Inclusive and diverse environment

6ca71cec29a6e466c88e.description:
**Job Summary**
  
Where state and federal laws/regulations allow, accountable for performing day-to-day non-clinical pharmacy operations, administrative activities; Ensures efficient pharmacy workflow and a positive patient experience. Serves as a full-time certified pharmacy technician. Responsible for operating pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions. Under the supervision of a pharmacist, supervising pharmacy technicians and pharmacy cashiers within the guidelines of authorized company policies, laws, regulations and business ethics. Responsible for the selection, scheduling, and development of pharmacy technician personnel. Leads training, coaching, and performance management of pharmacy technicians. Makes decisions regarding performance management including discipline and termination.
  
  
**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer complaints, helps respond to customers’ requests in a timely manner and answers non-clinical questions to ensure a positive customer experience. Models and shares customer service best practices.
* Develops strong relationships with customers by anticipating customer needs and proactively offering services to provide the best experience possible when using the pharmacy. Enhances customer experience by increasing focus on healthcare services.

**Operations**

* Responsible for assisting pharmacist in the delivery of patient care including patient registration, prescription data entry, preparation of medications for patients, counting, and verifying (where allowed by law). Completes patient and physician calls under the supervision of a pharmacist (where allowed by law). Under the supervision of a pharmacist assists with healthcare service offerings including administering vaccines, health screenings, and any health services allowed by law.
* Within the guidelines of authorized company policies, state and federal laws/regulations, exercises independent judgment to delegate, direct, and assign non-clinical work in the pharmacy. Ensures tasks are completed on-time and holds others accountable for efficient workflow.
* At the direction of the Pharmacy Manager or pharmacist, prepares, and files reports and records required by the company and various government agencies.
* Manages core pharmacy workflow and drives excellence in pharmacy operations. Coordinates and organizes pharmacy daily schedule of activities. Recommends allocation of pharmacy hours. Assures the pharmacy is clean, neat, orderly, and stocked with adequate supplies.
* Under the direction of the pharmacist, exercises independent judgment to ensure compliance and execution of all business administrative activities and pharmacy inventory management tasks that do not require pharmacist licensure. Manages annual inventory preparation.
* Accountable for completion of non-clinical patient calls.
* Drives new technology/ process roll out, champions change and engages team around action planning. Assures proper operation and maintenance of pharmacy department equipment. In collaboration with Pharmacy Manager, responsible for recordkeeping and ensuring security safeguards are in-place.
* Under supervision of the pharmacist, strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription-dispensing activities and understands their role in ensuring that the elements of Good Faith Dispensing are met.
* Maintains and applies knowledge of Company asset protection techniques. Supports Pharmacy Manager with diversion monitoring and reports any concerns that would compromise the security of the pharmacy to the Pharmacy Manager.
* Communicates prescription errors to the accountable pharmacist, and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Continuous Quality Improvement Program.
* Ensures the accurate processing of insurance claims to resolve customer issues and prevent payment rejections. Follows-up with insurance companies as well as medical providers and conducts or participates in 3rd party audit.
* Assists and supports Store Manager and Pharmacy Manager in analyzing and seeking to improve pharmacy financials, operational quality and customer service.
* Manages Community Outreach Portal and coordinates and, at the direction of the Pharmacy Manager, assigns pharmacists to off-site immunization clinics and community events. Builds and sustains relationships with retail partnerships.

**People & Performance Management**

* Leads performance management of technicians including making decisions and recommendations regarding discipline and termination. Follows constructive discipline policy to discipline, suspend, terminate or effectively recommend the same. Uses constructive discipline policy to ensure pharmacy technicians are compliant with state and federal laws. Holds technician accountable for attendance and timeliness. Maintains and improves performance of pharmacy through team member engagement and action planning.
* Accountable for technician hiring, on-boarding, training, and scheduling. Monitors and holds pharmacy technicians accountable for timely training completion. Follows established policies and procedures set by the company for scheduling and training.
* Accountable for identifying gaps in pharmacy operations knowledge among team members and supporting those team members in their training, either through hands-on training or assignment of learning modules.
* Assists Pharmacy Manager in monitoring that all pharmacy and team member licensures, registrations and certifications are active and in good standing/ compliant with all regulatory and legal requirements. Leverages Walgreens resources such as Walgreens Online Verification System to assist in documenting licensure status.
* Ensures proper procedures are followed for selection, recruitment, record retention, and training as required by Company policy and local, state and federal laws.

**Training & Personal Development**

* Maintains PTCB certification through the designated PTCB training program and/or state required certification/registration.
* Maintains and enhances current knowledge and skills related to pharmacy and healthcare.
* Obtains necessary certifications, education credits and training such as LTMP e-modules as required by the Company. Follows performance improvement plans offered by Pharmacy Manager.
* Seeks professional development by monitoring one’s own performance, solicits for constructive feedback, and leverages Healthcare Supervisor as mentor and coach.

**Communication**

* Communicates with pharmacy team, relaying messages from the support center or other key emails as required.
* Participates in key store/pharmacy meetings, including 5-minute meetings and weekly check-ins with the Store Manager
  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
  

* High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.
* PTCB certification (except in Puerto Rico).
* Has one year of work experience as a pharmacy technician in a retail or hospital setting.
* Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English (except in Puerto Rico).
* Requires willingness to work flexible schedule, including evening and weekend hours.
* Willingness to obtain active immunization certification within 90 days of hire (except in Community Specialty Pharmacy and Health System Pharmacy locations)
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Previous people management/ leadership experience.
* Previous work experience with Walgreens with an Exceeding Expectation on last performance evaluation.

We will consider employment of qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

b028faddb5cd9348935c.title: Senior Program Manager, Product & Marketing Operations
b028faddb5cd9348935c.description:
**Job Title:** Senior Program Manager, Product & Marketing Operations

**Location:** Yonkers, NY (Hybrid ) or Remote  
**Reports to:** Senior Director of Operations

**Salary:** $110-$130K

**About Bask & Lather Co.**

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing haircare brand built on culture, community, and results. As we scale across DTC, TikTok Shop, retail, and experiential channels, we require a highly disciplined Project Manager to drive end-to-end execution across new product development, marketing campaigns, and retail initiatives.

This role enables timely, accurate execution through clear ownership, integrated planning, early risk identification, and verified launch readiness.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager, Product & Marketing Operations to translate business priorities into completed product launches, marketing campaigns, and cross-functional business initiatives. Reporting to the Senior Director of Operations, this person personally builds and drives integrated project plans, resolves dependencies and blockers, holds owners accountable for commitments, and verifies that deliverables are approved, implemented, and complete.

This is a hands-on senior program management role accountable for integrated planning, proactive problem solving, and delivery across functions. The Program Manager challenges missed commitments, secures recovery plans, and escalates decisions with options and business impact, enabling execution without repeated follow-up.

The ideal candidate has personally managed physical consumer product launches and integrated marketing campaigns in a fast-paced environment, coordinating Brand, Operations, Supply Chain, Social, E-commerce, CRM, Paid Media, and external partners. The role owns planning, dependencies, delivery tracking, escalation, and completion verification. Functional leaders retain ownership of strategy, staffing, technical and creative quality, and approvals within their areas.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Project Ownership (Product + Campaigns)**

* Own execution for:
  + New product development (concept formulation packaging launch)
  + Marketing campaigns (sales, seasonal launches, partnerships, retail activations) and assigned cross-functional business initiatives, including channel launches and operational implementations
* Proactively manage projects end-to-end, identifying risks early and escalating when necessary with clear solutions
* Secure owners and delivery commitments, define completion criteria, and verify acceptance by the receiving team. Track missed commitments through recovery and closure.

**2. New Product Development (NPD) Execution**

* Manage full NPD lifecycle:
  + Concept and kickoff
  + R&D and formulation coordination
  + Packaging development
  + Labeling, claims, and compliance
  + Sampling, testing, and approvals
  + Launch readiness
* Ensure all SKUs, variants, and components are fully scoped from the start
* Coordinate across R&D, Ops, Supply Chain, Brand, and manufacturers

**3. Marketing Campaign Execution**

* Manage execution of:
  + Sales campaigns
  + Retail launches and activations
  + TV segments, influencer campaigns, and partnerships
* Ensure all assets, timelines, and deliverables are aligned across channels
* Coordinate with Social, Brand, E-commerce, and external partners

**4. Structured Project Kickoff & Scope Definition**

* Lead formal kickoff for every project to confirm scope, owners, dependencies, approval gates, and open decisions
* Define and validate scope during kickoff and planning:
  + All SKUs
  + All deliverables and assets
  + All timelines and dependencies
* Validate critical scope and launch requirements with stakeholders before execution; document assumptions and assign owners and deadlines for unresolved decisions
* Identify missing SKUs or deliverables early; manage approved scope changes and communicate their effect on timing, resources, and launch readiness

**5. Timeline & Critical Path Management**

* Build and maintain detailed timelines in project management tools
* Manage critical path across product development and campaigns
* Track dependencies and ensure alignment across teams
* Build backward plans using realistic lead times, approval gates, and resource availability; surface conflicts early and secure recovery actions when dates are at risk

**6. Retail & Launch Readiness**

* Ensure products and campaigns are fully launch-ready across:
  + DTC, including website and app
  + Retail and marketplaces, including Amazon and TikTok Shop
  + Media
* Confirm all requirements are completed before launch:
  + Packaging, labeling, compliance
  + Assets and approvals
  + Operational readiness

**7. Risk Management & Proactive Problem Solving**

* Identify risks early across all projects
* Communicate issues before deadlines are impacted
* Present solutions and recovery plans with accountable owners, revised dates, tradeoffs, and decisions required; escalate unresolved conflicts to the Senior Director of Operations
* Prevent execution breakdowns and last-minute scrambling

**8. Execution Accuracy & Attention to Detail**

* Ensure accuracy in:
  + Dates and timelines
  + Asset naming and organization
  + Campaign details and logistics
  + Product scope and SKUs
* Validate critical information, document assumptions and decisions, and resolve uncertainty proactively

**9. Asset & Deliverable Coordination**

* Track all creative and product assets (video, photo, copy, packaging)
* Verify completion through receiving-team acceptance, documented approvals, and launch-day checks. Confirm approved assets, listings, offers, links, and campaign components are implemented correctly across applicable channels. Track outstanding issues through resolution.
* Obtain and document signoffs from authorized functional approvers before external submissions. Track labeling, claims, and compliance review without acting as the technical or regulatory approver.

**10. Cross-Functional Alignment & Communication**

* Coordinate across:
  + Brand & Marketing
  + Social Media
  + E-commerce
  + Operations & Supply Chain
  + External vendors and partners
* Maintain one prioritized portfolio showing owners, milestones, dependencies, resource conflicts, and status. Obtain cross-functional commitments and escalate unresolved priority conflicts with options and business impact.
* Publish weekly updates covering completed work, upcoming commitments, overdue items, risks, recovery actions, and decisions needed. Label unconfirmed dates and assign owners and deadlines to resolve them. Facilitate working meetings that secure decisions and close actions.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Products launch against agreed plans with documented scope, required approvals, and readiness confirmed by receiving teams
* Campaign components are approved, handed off, and activated correctly across applicable channels; issues are tracked through resolution
* Portfolio reporting is dependable; SKU scope, dates, dependencies, and completion evidence are accurate and current
* Risks are identified early and resolved proactively
* Leadership receives timely, decision-ready escalations and spends less time chasing updates or reconnecting teams

**Qualifications**

* **PMP (Project Management Professional) certification preferred; demonstrated delivery experience is essential**
* 6+ years of relevant project or program management experience in fast-paced environments
* Required: Personally managed physical consumer products through development and launch, including formulation or R&D, packaging, testing, production, and commercialization dependencies
* Required: Managed integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels. Beauty or personal care experience preferred; relevant physical consumer product launch experience in CPG required.
* Strong cross-functional leadership across Brand, Operations, Supply Chain, and external partners
* Strong proficiency in project management tools (Monday.com preferred) and Excel; demonstrated ability to recover slipping projects and manage concurrent initiatives in a lean organization

**Core Competencies**

* **End-to-End Ownership:** Drives projects from concept to completion
* **Process Discipline:** Applies structured methodologies consistently
* **Attention to Detail:** Catches what others miss
* **Proactive Communication:** Flags risks early and clearly
* **Execution Excellence:** Personally drives work through completion, verifies implementation, and delivers without constant follow-up
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Secures commitments, challenges missed deadlines, resolves blockers, and escalates decisions with options

**Non-Negotiables**

* Validate critical information and document assumptions
* Review relevant requirements, resolve open questions proactively, and escalate uncertainty that threatens delivery
* Use kickoff to confirm scope, owners, dependencies, and open decisions; update plans as approved priorities or scope change
* Deadlines are proactively managed, not reacted to
* Verify accuracy at handoffs and launch checkpoints; maintain an auditable record of approvals and completion

**Why This Role Matters**

As Bask & Lather continues to scale, execution quality across both product development and marketing campaigns is critical. This role enables teams to move quickly through reliable plans, clear accountability, verified handoffs, and timely decisions. Conduct post-launch retrospectives and implement corrective actions. Routine copy review, social scheduling, and departmental production remain with functional teams so this role can focus on cross-functional delivery.

We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We provide reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs.**

deec15fd97932934b071.description:
Vice President of Operations

**Company:** Transcarent  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Remote  
**Department:** Business Operations  
**Level:** Vice President

Position Overview

Transcarent is seeking an experienced Vice President of Operations to lead critical business operations, strengthen service delivery, and help the organization scale while maintaining a high standard of execution.

Healthcare is complicated for the people trying to navigate it and for the organizations responsible for providing access to care. Transcarent operates in this environment, bringing together technology, healthcare services, and navigation capabilities to make healthcare easier to access and manage.

The Vice President of Operations will work closely with executive leadership to oversee operational performance, improve business processes, and ensure that service delivery supports both customer expectations and the company's financial objectives.

This is a hands-on executive leadership role. The person in this position will be expected to understand how the business operates, identify where performance is falling short, and work directly with functional leaders to address operational challenges.

We're looking for someone who has managed complex service operations, understands the financial economics of healthcare delivery, and can build the processes and management practices needed to support a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

Provide executive leadership across business operations, service delivery, and operational performance management.

Work with executive leadership to establish operating priorities, develop annual plans, and align organizational resources with business objectives.

Oversee operational initiatives involving healthcare navigation, member support, service coordination, and customer-facing business processes.

Partner with Finance to develop operating budgets, evaluate cost structures, monitor financial performance, and identify opportunities to improve operating margins.

Collaborate with healthcare operations and service delivery teams to strengthen service quality, improve responsiveness, and support consistent member experiences.

Establish performance measures covering service efficiency, operational costs, customer satisfaction, productivity, and delivery effectiveness.

Work closely with Product and Technology leadership to evaluate operational requirements, improve workflows, and support the implementation of technology-enabled services.

Assess staffing requirements, workforce productivity, vendor performance, and resource allocation to ensure operational capacity is aligned with business demand.

Review financial and operating reports to identify performance gaps, assess business risks, and recommend practical improvements.

Support the operational planning and implementation of new customer relationships, healthcare partnerships, and service expansion initiatives.

Collaborate with Commercial and Customer Success teams to ensure operational capabilities support contractual commitments and customer expectations.

Evaluate third-party service providers, vendor agreements, and operating expenses to identify cost management opportunities and strengthen service delivery.

Develop scalable operating procedures, management reporting practices, and internal controls that support organizational growth.

Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives involving Finance, Operations, Technology, Product, and Customer Success.

Build and mentor operational leadership teams while maintaining clear accountability for service quality, financial performance, and execution.

Qualifications

15+ years of progressive experience in business operations, healthcare services, digital health, operational management, or related leadership positions.

At least 7 years of senior leadership experience with responsibility for large-scale operations, service delivery, and financial performance.

Experience working with healthcare technology companies, health plans, employer-sponsored healthcare services, care navigation platforms, or healthcare service organizations is strongly preferred.

Demonstrated ability to manage complex operations, lead cross-functional teams, and improve service performance while maintaining financial discipline.

Strong financial management experience, including operating budgets, cost analysis, financial forecasting, resource allocation, and profitability improvement.

Experience overseeing service delivery operations, workforce planning, vendor management, and operational performance measurement.

Solid understanding of healthcare service economics, customer commitments, operational risk, and technology-enabled service delivery.

Ability to evaluate operating data, financial reports, and business performance measures to make informed management decisions.

Experience working with senior executives, healthcare partners, customer-facing teams, and technology leadership.

Strong organizational leadership, communication, negotiation, and analytical problem-solving skills.

Experience leading operational improvements, managing organizational change, and implementing scalable business processes.

Ability to manage distributed teams and coordinate complex operational activities in a remote working environment.

A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Operations Management, or a related discipline is required. An MBA, MHA, or relevant advanced degree is preferred.

Ideal Candidate

You've spent your career leading operations where execution matters every day. You understand that even a well-designed strategy can fail if the organization doesn't have the people, processes, and financial discipline to deliver on its commitments.

You know how to manage complex service environments where customer expectations are high, operating costs must be controlled, and performance needs to be measured consistently.

You are comfortable reviewing budgets, evaluating staffing decisions, analyzing operating margins, and making changes that improve efficiency without compromising service quality.

You understand the challenges of healthcare operations, including the need to coordinate multiple stakeholders, maintain reliable service delivery, and respond to changing customer requirements.

You bring a practical management style. You set clear expectations, address problems directly, and give capable teams the support and accountability they need to perform.

Most importantly, you know how to build operations that can grow without losing control of cost, quality, or customer experience.

For an experienced operations executive with a background in healthcare technology or healthcare services, this role offers the opportunity to contribute to business performance and operational development in a complex, evolving industry.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/15/2026.

* Lead managed learning operations engagements from transition through steady-state delivery, including learning administration, content development, reporting, vendor management, and service performance management
* Manage delivery plans, service-level agreements, operational metrics, risks, issues, and corrective actions across assigned client workstreams
* Direct global delivery teams and coordinate work across Deloitte teams, client stakeholders, and technology and delivery partners
* Identify and implement process improvements using artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and learning technologies to improve efficiency, quality, and learner outcomes
* Lead client governance activities, including status reporting, performance reviews, decision tracking, and delivery communications

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

*Please note that the salary range referenced is a general guideline only. Salary differentials are based on multiple factors including (but not limited to), geographic location, education/training, years of relevant experience/seniority, merit, qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Mohawk Global considers all of these variables when extending an offer of employment.*

**Who We Are:** Mohawk Global is a 350+ person team of logistics and trade specialists dedicated to fulfilling the supply chain needs of our customers with a strong emphasis on customs brokerage, domestic and international transportation, trade compliance, education, and consulting. Our business practices are driven and exhibited daily by our three core values: to ENRICH purposefully, to CARE personally and to DELIVER professionally. To learn more about our core values and what makes us truly unique in our industry, please click here.

We pride ourselves in being a highly employee-centric organization that truly puts our people (and clients) first! At Mohawk, these aren’t just words, they are demonstrable values that we put into action by our behaviors each day. We have been certified as a “Great Place To Work” for the past thirteen years…see what our amazing people have to say about us here: Mohawk Global - A Great Place to Work!

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Account Manager for Inland Services is responsible for strengthening customer relationships, driving service performance, and supporting business growth across assigned inland and final mile accounts. The role connects customer needs with Operations, Carrier Procurement, Pricing, and Systems to improve execution, resolve challenges, and identify opportunities for profitable growth.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own and strengthen relationships across an assigned portfolio, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor.
* Understand customer objectives, shipping patterns, delivery requirements, facility constraints, communication preferences, and success measures.
* Establish a consistent customer communication cadence that includes performance updates, issue follow-up, documented next steps, and business growth.
* Lead internal account reviews and strategic discussions that connect customer priorities with Mohawk Global inland and final mile solutions.
* Build long-term partnerships that support customer satisfaction, retention, and account expansion.
* Partner with operational teams, primarily Inland, Import Operations, and Business Development, to ensure pickup, linehaul, appointment, delivery, proof-of-delivery, and exception-management activities align with customer commitments.
* Guide service transitions and location launches while maintaining continuity and clear ownership.
* Develop and maintain account-specific SOPs, routing instructions, escalation paths, reporting requirements, and service standards.
* Monitor shipment and delivery performance, including on-time service, exceptions, accessorial activity, claims trends, and recurring operational gaps.
* Coordinate solutions for time-sensitive, high-touch, appointment, inside-delivery, liftgate, white-glove, expedited, and other specialized final mile requirements included in the customer solution.
* Promote complete and accurate shipment documentation, status updates, proof-of-delivery records, and customer-facing reporting.
* Own internal customer-impacting escalations from acknowledgement through resolution, recovery communication, and documented closure.
* Analyze service failures and performance trends to identify root causes, corrective actions, owners, and due dates.
* Balance customer needs, carrier capability, operational feasibility, cost, and contractual requirements when developing solutions.
* Proactively identify risks related to capacity, delivery constraints, recurring accessorials, communication gaps, claims, or service inconsistency.
* Escalate material commercial, financial, compliance, or customer-retention risks to the appropriate leader.
* Coordinate across Operations, Carrier Procurement, Pricing, Systems, Sales, and Leadership to deliver consistent account outcomes.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and other internal customer meetings using clear performance data, business insights, action plans, and growth recommendations.
* Communicate account health, opportunities, customer feedback, unresolved risks, and resource needs to leadership.
* Ensure handoffs between the internal customer, operations, and supporting functions are documented, timely, and understood.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to account support and operational team members as appropriate.
* Manage portfolio performance with accountability for retention, revenue growth, service quality, and overall account health.
* Identify opportunities to expand internal customer relationships through additional lanes, modes, locations, service levels, or complementary logistics solutions.
* Partner with Pricing and Operations to evaluate margin performance, accessorial trends, service costs, and solution sustainability.
* Maintain accurate account documentation, customer commitments, forecasts, opportunity records, and meeting notes.
* Support billing accuracy and timely resolution of internal customer disputes, rate discrepancies, accessorial questions, and documentation gaps.

**BENCHMARKS FOR MEASURING SUCCESS:**

* Maintains strong customer satisfaction and retention across the assigned portfolio.
* Improves on-time service, shipment visibility, delivery consistency, and issue-resolution performance.
* Completes scheduled business reviews and closes documented actions by agreed due dates.
* Reduces recurring escalations through root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
* Maintains current account documentation, SOPs, customer commitments, and performance reporting.
* Identifies and advances qualified opportunities for profitable account growth.
* Strengthens alignment and accountability across customer, operations, procurement, pricing, and systems teams.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Inland transportation and final mile delivery operations, terminology, service requirements, and exception management.
* Transportation management systems, shipment visibility tools, and customer reporting.
* Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for performance analysis, business reviews, and action tracking.
* SOP development, process documentation, KPI reporting, and root cause analysis.
* Working knowledge of pricing, accessorials, proof of delivery, claims, appointment delivery, and specialized delivery requirements.
* Strong problem-solving skills related to deliveries and cross-dock services within the international logistics industry.

**Business Skills:**

* Account management, customer retention, and consultative relationship development.
* Commercial awareness, opportunity identification, and solution development.
* Negotiation, expectation management, and conflict resolution.
* Data interpretation, performance storytelling, planning, and prioritization.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and urgent service issues while maintaining disciplined follow-through.

**Leadership Skills:**

* Ownership and accountability for account outcomes.
* Executive-ready communication and meeting facilitation.
* Cross-functional influence without direct authority.
* Sound judgment, decisive escalation, and disciplined follow-through.
* Coaching, knowledge sharing, and support of team development.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, final mile operations, account management, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage customer relationships and resolve complex service issues.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Experience using performance data and business reviews to drive corrective action and customer alignment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and experience working in TMS, CRM, or shipment visibility systems.
* Experience within a 3PL, freight brokerage, managed transportation, inland, import, or final mile environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience understanding complex internal client requirements and developing tailored, scalable transportation solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
* Experience with account implementations, SOP design, QBRs, margin review, and cross-functional improvement projects.

**OFFICE / WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

This position operates in a professional office environment (and/or remotely from a home office) with a quiet to moderate noise level and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such computers, photocopying machines and storage/filing cabinets. This is a largely sedentary role, however, lifting items under 25 pounds as well as the ability to bend, stand and walk short distances may be required.

**Travel Requirement:** Quarterly travel for customer visits, business reviews, facility meetings, and internal meetings.
