89498c1d97e9d4e26406.description:
**Onlie/Digital Marketing Specialist**

**Company:** Blize Home Care.  
**Location:** Hercules/Hybrid (as applicable).  
**Employment Type:** Full-time/Part-term Contract position.

Blize Home Care is a U.S.-based home care company dedicated to providing families and clients with reliable, high-quality caregiving services. We support individuals in the comfort of their homes, assisted living facilities, nursing homes, hospitals, and independent living communities throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.

Our caregivers are trained and certified, with ongoing monthly education led by a Registered Nurse. Our training focuses on elderly care, young adult care, dementia support, and the delivery of compassionate, dependable care.

At Blize Home Care, we are committed to helping clients maintain their comfort, dignity, safety, and quality of life.

**Role Overview:**

Blize Home Care is seeking a results-driven **Digital Marketing Specialist with a strong background in Search Engine Optimization (SEO)** to lead and execute our digital growth strategy.

The ideal candidate understands how SEO, content marketing, website optimization, and paid digital advertising work together to increase online visibility, attract qualified leads, and drive business growth.

This role is an excellent opportunity for a marketing professional who enjoys combining analytical thinking, creative content development, and data-driven decision-making. Experience in healthcare, home care, or other regulated industries is an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

### **SEO Strategy and Optimization:**

* Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve organic traffic, search engine rankings, and website conversions.
* Conduct keyword research to identify relevant search terms and growth opportunities.
* Perform technical SEO audits and implement improvements related to website structure, indexing, crawlability, page speed, and mobile usability.
* Optimize website pages, metadata, internal links, and content for search engines and users.
* Develop ethical link-building strategies to strengthen website authority.

### **Content Marketing:**

* Plan, write, edit, and optimize blog posts, service pages, landing pages, and other website content.
* Develop content strategies aligned with customer needs, search intent, and business objectives.
* Apply local SEO strategies to improve visibility for home care services throughout the Bay Area.
* Ensure healthcare-related content is accurate, trustworthy, accessible, and appropriately reviewed.

### **Digital Advertising and Conversion Optimization:**

* Support and optimize paid campaigns, including Google Ads and social media advertising.
* Improve landing pages, calls to action, and website user experiences to increase inquiries and conversions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align marketing campaigns with business goals.

### **Analytics and Performance Reporting:**

* Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools.
* Track key performance indicators, including organic traffic, keyword rankings, lead generation, and conversion rates.
* Prepare regular performance reports and recommend data-driven improvements.
* Monitor search engine algorithm updates, industry trends, and emerging digital marketing practices.

### **Collaboration and Compliance:**

* Work with management, design, and relevant healthcare professionals to maintain consistent brand messaging.
* Follow applicable healthcare advertising requirements and privacy guidelines.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve online visibility, brand awareness, and lead quality.

**Requirements:**

* At least **2 years of experience in digital marketing**, with a strong focus on SEO.
* Demonstrated success improving organic traffic, search visibility, and website performance.
* Hands-on experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, and link building.
* Experience managing websites through WordPress or another content management system.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
* Understanding of keyword research, local SEO, and conversion rate optimization.
* Excellent written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and measure results against business goals.
* Experience in healthcare, home care, senior care, medtech, or another regulated industry is a plus.

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunity to work with a growing healthcare technology company.
* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
* Flexible work environment.
* Direct impact on brand growth and market visibility.

**How to Apply:**

Send your CV and portfolio (or examples of SEO results/projects) to hr@blizecare.com

Interested candidates are invited to submit their **resume/CV and a portfolio or examples of SEO projects and results** to:

**Email:** hr@blizecare.com

Please include a summary of your SEO experience, the tools you have used, and examples of measurable results you have achieved.

We look forward to hearing from qualified candidates who are passionate about digital marketing and helping families connect with quality home care services.

0ed80445d67ff06a76df.title: Customer Success Manager
0ed80445d67ff06a76df.description:
The Customer Success Manager is the operational engine of day-to-day service delivery. CSMs manage front-line staff, maintain daily contact with onsite client representatives, and ensure each shift runs to standard. CSMs are the primary relationship owner for onsite contacts (property managers, assistant property managers, and building staff) and the primary leadership contact for OICs and front-line officers.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Oversee and manage front-line staff and OICs assigned to the portfolio, serving as direct supervisor for day-to-day site operations.
* Maintain daily contact with onsite client representatives and respond to all communications within one hour during business hours.
* Hold bi-weekly coaching sessions with OICs using a mission-oriented, site-specific agenda, scheduled in Google Calendar and tracked in HubSpot.
* Hold monthly town hall meetings with site teams, in partnership with the OIC, giving staff an opportunity to provide input.
* Own payroll accuracy by approving timecards and ESSL requests weekly by noon on Mondays, ensuring budgeted hours are not exceeded, and annotating variances on the Base44 exceptions report.
* Own rolling 30-day schedules, due the last Monday of every month, and maintain the master schedule and roster with SOC, updated monthly.
* Manage OJT and quarterly training at all assigned sites, due at the close of each quarter, with paperwork submitted via CuroShift.
* Conduct a minimum of three unscheduled site check-ins per month and document all findings in HubSpot.
* Respond to all emergency issues (call-outs, no-shows, onsite incidents), escalating and communicating to the client and Portfolio Manager as soon as issues are known.
* Log all client interactions and site activity in HubSpot in real time. If it is not in HubSpot, it did not happen.
* Ensure visitor verification, logging compliance, post order adherence, and quality standards are consistently met at every site.
* Manage training follow-up, action item tracking, and site documentation control.
* Act as the primary escalation point for OICs before a matter escalates to the Portfolio Manager.

**Client Engagement Cadence**

* **Daily:** Available and responsive to onsite client representatives, with email responses within one hour during business hours.
* **Bi-weekly:** Pre-planned check-in with the property manager or assistant property manager, with minutes logged in HubSpot and a follow-up action plan sent by COB the same day.
* **Monthly:** Town hall with the site team, plus a minimum of three unscheduled check-ins.

#### **Experience**

Required

* 2 year(s): Supervisor / management experience leading teams of 5 or more
* 4 year(s): Experience in customer facing roles

#### **Education**

Required

* Associates or better

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

**A path for every ambition.**

At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day.

We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them.

Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here.

Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage.

Your ambition has a home here.

**Position Summary: Payroll Specialist II**

*HCM Unlocked is a technology-enabled managed service provider helping organizations improve the way they manage human capital technology and operations. The company provides managed services and consulting across payroll, tax, HR, benefits, leave of absence, compliance, technology implementation and optimization, data governance and related workforce services. Its proprietary DELTA technology supports HCM data migration, validation and management across technology environments.*

*HCM Unlocked is part of Specialty Program Group, LLC (SPG), which is part of HUB International. When you join the team at HUB International, you become part of one of the world’s largest insurance brokers and financial services firms, providing risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management products and services. With more than 21,000 employees and 700+ offices across North America, HUB combines the resources and reach of a global organization with the entrepreneurial culture and specialized expertise of its businesses.*

We are seeking a highly motivated and driven individual to join our team in the role of Payroll Specialist II. As an employer, we value individuals who possess a strong sense of ownership, are self-driven, and demonstrate genuine enthusiasm for the work they do. This position requires an individual that has strong client relationship skills, is system driven, has meticulous attention to detail, and strives to deliver an excellent client experience.

**We’re looking for candidates with extensive experience in one or more of the following systems: Paylocity, Paycor, UKG Ready, UKG Pro, Ceridian Dayforce, ADP WFN, Paycom and/or Paychex**

**Candidate Profile:**

* We are looking for a candidate who is customer obsessed. Your mission is to earn and maintain the loyalty of your customers by proactively understanding and satisfying their needs. You are the owner of this client relationship and responsible for the client’s longevity with HCM Unlocked.
* Excellent communication skills are vital for this role. You must articulate your ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing. Prompt responsiveness and communication with your clients and peers are critical to the success of this role.
* You take ownership of your work, approach it with a sense of responsibility, urgency, and accountability. You are someone who thrives on taking initiative, setting goals, and driving accurate and timely payrolls to successful completion.
* You are self-motivated and possess a strong work ethic with a rigorous attention to detail.
* You are capable of working independently, managing your time effectively with multiple clients, and delivering high-quality results even in the face of challenges. Your ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines will be critical to your success in this role.
* We believe that enthusiasm is contagious and can drive positive change. We are looking for a candidate who genuinely enjoys delivering an exceptional customer experience, has a passion for payroll, and brings energy and excitement to their team and to their customers.
* You must be an analytical thinker with a passion for numbers.
* You approach challenges with a positive mindset, proactively seek solutions, and adapt quickly to changing circumstances.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for overseeing, preparing, and producing accurate and timely payrolls for multiple clients, in multiple locations (states), based on state and federal regulations and company policies
* Checking customers employees’ timesheets for accuracy

* Make adjustments in pay for raises, bonuses, commission, and severance
* Review and validate payroll reports for accuracy, investigating and resolving any discrepancies
* Maintain confidentiality and security of all client files, payroll information, and employee PII
* Analyze payroll results and other Human Resources reports to answer complex questions and recommend courses of action while exercising independent judgment and discretion
* Respond to payroll-related inquiries from client and their employees
* Process employee garnishments
* Coordinate payroll general ledger processing with accounting
* Prepare time and labor files
* Input employee changes, maintain deductions, banking information, and employee maintenance items

* Provide service support to employees, other departments, and management

**Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):**

* 7 or more years’ proven experience processing end-to-end payroll preferably in a medium to large organization
* Prior experience working in a multi-client environment is required
* Expert knowledge of either Paylocity, Paycor, UKG Ready, UKG Pro, Ceridian Dayforce, ADP WFN, Paycom and/or Paychex
* In-depth knowledge of payroll processes, regulations, and best practices
* Complex analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
* Self-starter who is willing to take initiative with little direction or guidance
* Demonstrated organizational and time management abilities
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team
* Educated on compliance with federal, state, and local payroll laws and requirements
* Certified Payroll Professional certification a plus
* Excellent math and numerical skills
* Proficient in Excel including pivot tables and VLOOKUP

**Compensation & Benefits:**

The expected pay range for this position is $30.29 - $32.69/hr and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include health/dental/vision/life/disability insurance, FSA, HSA and 401(k) accounts, paid-time-off benefits, and eligible bonuses, equity and commissions for some positions.

#SPG

**What we offer you**

We invest in your growth. HUB offers structured training, licensing support and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career.

* Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching and company-paid life and disability plans
* Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance
* A collaborative, high-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career

**The HUB difference**

HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

We are a locally owned, growing home care agency dedicated to providing compassionate, high-quality care that helps seniors and adults remain safe and independent in their own homes. As a smaller agency, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We know our employees by name, value every team member's contributions, and foster a supportive, family-like culture where everyone works together toward the same mission.

We are seeking an organized, energetic, and people-focused Part-Time Recruiter to help us attract, hire, and retain exceptional caregivers who share our commitment to providing outstanding care. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys connecting with people, building relationships, and making a meaningful difference behind the scenes. * Conduct phone, Zoom, and in-person interviews
* Coordinate hiring, onboarding, orientation, and training schedules
* Maintain accurate applicant and employee records

* Follow up with all caregivers regarding ongoing performance evaluations, disciplinary actions, and job performance reviews.
* Monitor caregiver performance, address concerns, and ensure timely completion of evaluations.
* Document performance issues, corrective actions, and follow-up outcomes.
* Communicate performance expectations and provide guidance to caregivers to promote accountability and quality of care.
* Coordinate with management regarding caregiver performance concerns, disciplinary procedures, and improvement plans.

**Qualifications**

* Previous recruiting, staffing, or human resources experience required
* Home care, healthcare, or caregiver recruiting experience preferred
* Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
* Strong communication, relationship-building, and customer service skills
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities
* Proficient with Microsoft Office and online recruiting platforms
* High school diploma or equivalent required

**Why Join Our Team?**

When you join our agency, you're not just filling a position—you're becoming part of a close-knit team that genuinely supports one another.

**We offer:**

* Competitive pay
* Paid time off
* Supportive, family-oriented work environment
* Direct access to leadership with opportunities to share ideas and make an impact
* Less bureaucracy and more collaboration than larger agencies
* Recognition for your contributions and achievements

If you're organized, thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy building relationships, and want to work for a company where your contributions are valued and appreciated, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help us build a team that makes a difference every day.

ba5d35259f0de8478d31.description:
**Title:** **Dental** **Logistics Operations Manager**

**Location:** **Hybrid NY, NJ, PA, TX, IL or IN**

**Who we are:**

**Voted one of the Nation's Best and Brightest Companies to Work for, Kuraray America, Inc. (KAI)** is a global leader in specialty chemical, fiber, and resin production. With top-of-the-line research and production facilities and a vast network of supplies from around the world, Kuraray leads the industry in specialty dental, fiber, resin, and elastomer products. Kuraray America is a wholly owned subsidiary of Kuraray Company, Ltd. Based in Tokyo, Japan. Kuraray has operations in 32 countries and employs more than 12,000 employees, including over 800 in the United States.

**Why Kuraray:**

Kuraray is building a better tomorrow, today. Our team members are dedicated to expanding our business with committed professionals who share essential values such as integrity, excellence, teamwork, and accountability.

As a part of Kuraray America, Inc., our team shares the advantages of working for the leader in specialty chemicals, resins, and fibers. Our international presence and resources allow us to be a world-leading innovator in the industries we service. Yet, despite our size, our people are more than just a number. As a new team member, you can expect to earn responsibility quickly. Our commitment to our people is visible in our comprehensive benefits package. As a Kuraray team member, you will have the opportunity to enjoy competitive salaries and benefits, incentive opportunities, and an excellent work environment.

**Position Summary:**

The Dental Logistics Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day execution and development of warehouse, inventory, order fulfillment, and distribution operations for the Dental business. The position oversees all Dental shipments through the business's dedicated third-party logistics (3PL) and fulfillment partner, currently supporting dealer orders, e-commerce orders, and sample programs.

This is a hands-on business operations role requiring an understanding of Dental products, customer requirements, and channel-specific fulfillment processes. The Manager is accountable for accurate and timely fulfillment, including reconciliation of order, inventory, and shipment records; resolution of operational exceptions; and effective execution by the 3PL. The role includes SKU-level operational controls, piece picking, small-parcel shipping, and fulfillment requirements that vary by order type and customer channel.

The Manager also develops the capabilities needed to expand direct-to-end-user sales, e-commerce, and sample activities. This includes evaluating future fulfillment models, proposing operational and system designs, and leading approved implementation projects as the business grows.

The position supervises one direct report and works closely with Commercial, Customer Service, Finance, IT, and external service providers. Corporate Logistics retains responsibility for enterprise transportation strategy, carrier governance, global logistics standards, and customs and trade compliance. Within those policies and approved provider arrangements, the Manager owns Dental-specific fulfillment requirements and daily operational execution.

**Responsibilities:**

**Dental Fulfillment & 3PL Management**

* Manage the operational relationship with Dental's dedicated 3PL and fulfillment partner, overseeing receiving, storage, picking, packing, shipping, and returns.
* Take responsibility for fulfillment execution across dealer, e-commerce, and sample orders, ensuring each order type meets its applicable accuracy, service, and delivery requirements.
* Monitor daily order flow and shipment completion, reconcile order and shipment records, and resolve order holds, picking errors, shipping discrepancies, and other fulfillment exceptions.
* Translate Dental product, business, and customer requirements into documented warehouse procedures and service standards.
* Establish and monitor 3PL service expectations, investigate performance gaps, and drive corrective actions.
* Maintain product-specific handling and inventory controls, including lot traceability, expiration management, and storage requirements where applicable.

**Inventory Control & Inbound Coordination**

* Maintain accurate inventory records and reconcile inventory balances and transactions between the ERP and 3PL Warehouse Management System (WMS).
* Coordinate cycle counts and physical inventory activities, investigate discrepancies, and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor receiving progress and inventory availability, and communicate operational constraints affecting order fulfillment.
* Coordinate Dental inbound priorities, receiving requirements, and warehouse readiness with Corporate Logistics, approved transportation providers, and the 3PL.
* Support timely warehouse receipt by identifying and resolving Dental-specific operational issues and escalating transportation or compliance matters to Corporate Logistics and Legal.

**Distribution & Delivery Execution**

* Coordinate outbound fulfillment and delivery execution through approved providers, with particular attention to small-parcel shipments and direct-to-end-user requirements.
* Monitor shipment visibility and delivery performance, and coordinate the resolution of delayed, lost, damaged, or incorrectly delivered shipments.
* Improve packing, order consolidation, shipping workflows, and other operational processes to support service quality and cost efficiency.
* Partner with Corporate Logistics on transportation requirements or provider changes that require corporate review or approval.

**Direct-Selling, E-commerce & Systems Development**

* Develop fulfillment capabilities to support growth in direct-to-end-user sales, e-commerce, and sample activities.
* Define operational requirements and propose future process and system designs, including WMS, and e-commerce integrations, in partnership with IT, Accounting, Corporate Logistics and relevant business teams.
* Design order-to-shipment and returns workflows that support inventory visibility, accurate transactions, and reconciliation with Customer Service and Finance.
* Evaluate fulfillment capacity and future operating models, including expansion of 3PL services, additional fulfillment partners, and potential in-house operations.
* Develop recommendations and implementation plans for approved changes, including resource requirements, operational controls, testing, training.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in fulfillment, distribution, warehousing, logistics, or supply chain operations.

* Minimum of five (5) years of people supervisor experience.
* Experience managing 3PL providers and warehouse fulfillment operations, including SKU-level piece picking and small-parcel shipments.
* Experience supporting multiple order types or sales channels, such as dealer distribution, e-commerce, direct customer orders, or sample fulfillment.
* Hands-on experience with inventory reconciliation and the resolution of order, inventory, and shipment exceptions.
* Experience using ERP and/or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), with the ability to define operational requirements and support system or workflow improvements.
* Experience developing operational procedures, monitoring performance metrics, and implementing process improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead operational projects and coordinate internal stakeholders and external service providers.
* Ability to learn Dental products and business requirements and translate them into practical fulfillment processes and controls.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to supervise and develop a direct report and drive accountability with external partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% of the time, including visits to fulfillment facilities in Kentucky for operational reviews, implementation activities, and issue resolution, and team meetings in New York, California and Texas.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in dental, medical device, healthcare product, or other businesses requiring product-specific handling and traceability.
* Experience launching or expanding e-commerce or direct-to-customer fulfillment operations.
* Experience with ERP/WMS integration, fulfillment system implementation, or evaluation of warehouse operating models.

**Competencies**:

* Customer Focus
  + Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
* Business Insight
  + Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals.
* Cultivates Innovation
  + Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.

* Action Oriented
  + Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
* Ensures Accountability
  + Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* Drives Results
  + Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstance
* Collaborates
  + Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
* Values Difference
  + Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization
* Communicates Effectively
  + Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
* Courage
  + Stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.
* Instills Trust
  + Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* Situational Adaptability
  + Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.

**Benfits**

We offer a competitive compensation package that includes base pay and an annual incentive. This program is designed to reward individual performance and align overall rewards with corporate and team performance.

Our employees benefit from a robust healthcare package that includes wellness reimbursements, along with generous perks such as three weeks of paid time off, ten company holidays, paid parental leave, education reimbursement, and a matching 401k plan, among other offerings.

**Compensation:**  
The expected base salary range for this position is **$116,930 - $175,000** **annually**.

cf2b5118c90cbc2f8b4b.title: Area Facilities Operations Specialist (AFOS)
cf2b5118c90cbc2f8b4b.description:
*Mahalo for your interest in this role! Please see the full position description below and click Start Your Application when ready.*

* **Hourly rate ranges** from $29.75 to $32.50 per hour depending on experience with an additional $5.09 per hour for Health and Welfare
* **Duration** - Long term
* **Location** - Edgemont USARC/AMSA #31 (G). 2101 S Delchester Road. Newtown Square PA, 19073-5002

**Other locations of responsibility**: LTC Mark Phelan Memorial USARC, , PA Lancaster PA / Reading USARC Center, Reading PA 19607 / York Memorial USARC, York PA 17406

**Position Summary:**

LAUKOA is seeking an Area Facilities Operations Specialist (AFOS) to support the U.S. Army Reserve 99th Readiness Division Directorate of Public Works.

The Area Facilities Operations Specialist provides field-based and office-based facilities operations support for an assigned area of responsibility. The AFOS monitors facility conditions; conducts site visits; identifies, documents, and validates maintenance and repair requirements; supports work-order review; performs quality-assurance surveillance; coordinates customer and site-access requirements; and prepares technical findings for Government review.

The AFOS serves as a key field link among facility customers, Government personnel, service providers, Regional Facilities Operations Specialists, and Facilities Project Development Specialists. The position supports safe, functional, secure, and well-maintained facilities and assists with the identification and documentation of conditions that may require environmental review, in accordance with applicable standards and operational requirements.

**Work Arrangement:**

This is a field-and-office position supporting facilities operations within an assigned area of responsibility. The Area Facilities Operations Specialist conducts routine facility site visits, condition assessments, maintenance and repair coordination, customer engagement, and computer-based administrative and reporting work.

Travel within the assigned area of responsibility is required and is generally local to the designated duty station. A Government-provided vehicle is available for authorized business travel to Army Reserve Centers.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**The Area Facilities Operations Specialist shall:**

* Conduct routine and as-required facility site visits to monitor the physical and functional condition of building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, structural, life-safety, and related facility components.
* Identify, document, and validate facility deficiencies, maintenance requirements, repair needs, and customer concerns through site inspections, field observations, photographs, measurements, and other supporting information.
* Review submitted work-order requests for completeness and technical sufficiency; identify missing information; and prepare recommendations for Government review and disposition.
* Perform facility condition assessments and quality-assurance surveillance of maintenance, repair, and facility-improvement work; document observations, deficiencies, and facility conditions; and prepare findings for Government review.
* Coordinate site access, customer communication, work scheduling information, and field conditions with Government personnel, facility customers, service providers, and other stakeholders.
* Support the Regional Facilities Operations Specialist in maintaining awareness of facility conditions, maintenance requirements, recurring issues, customer concerns, and operational impacts across the assigned portfolio.
* Provide facility-condition information, customer requirements, photographs, measurements, system information, and technical observations to support project-package development by Facilities Project Development Specialists.
* Assist with the identification, documentation, and validation of requirements for Regional Facilities Operations Specialist Annual Work Plans and Five-Year Plans.
* Identify and document observed facility conditions that may present environmental, safety, maintenance, or operational concerns; coordinate findings with appropriate Government personnel for review and disposition.
* Apply a working knowledge of environmental-compliance considerations applicable to facility operations and maintenance when conducting field assessments, documenting conditions, and identifying potential concerns.
* Maintain accurate inspection documentation, work-order notes, facility records, correspondence, and other required administrative records.
* Use Microsoft Office applications and assigned Government systems to prepare reports, track requirements, document site visits, and communicate status.
* Coordinate professionally with Government personnel, Regional Facilities Operations Specialists, Facilities Project Development Specialists, facility customers, service providers, and other stakeholders.
* Perform other related duties within the scope of the position.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of four years of experience in facilities operations, building maintenance, facility inspections, construction, building systems, public works, property management, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated knowledge of commercial, institutional, industrial, or similar building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, structural, and general building-maintenance components.
* Experience conducting facility inspections, condition assessments, maintenance coordination, quality-assurance surveillance, work-order review, or comparable facilities-support activities.
* Working knowledge of environmental-compliance considerations applicable to facility operations and maintenance, including the ability to identify and document observed potential environmental concerns and coordinate findings with appropriate Government personnel.
* Ability to independently conduct site visits, document facility conditions, prepare clear written findings, manage multiple requirements, and coordinate professionally with customers, Government personnel, and service providers.
* Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to operate a Government-provided vehicle for authorized business travel.
* Reliable transportation to and from the assigned duty location.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Must be able to successfully complete and maintain the background investigation required for access to Government facilities and systems.
* Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable preemployment screening, reference checks, and installation-access requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Five or more years of directly relevant facilities operations, facilities maintenance, construction, building-system inspection, public-works, or property-management experience.
* Experience supporting U.S. Army Reserve, Department of War, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, or other Federal facilities programs.
* Experience supporting geographically dispersed facilities, multiple customer locations, or regional facilities portfolios.
* Experience with HVAC, electrical, plumbing, structural, fire/life-safety, utility, or building automation systems.
* Experience reviewing work orders, performing facility condition assessments, supporting maintenance planning, documenting facility deficiencies, or conducting quality-assurance surveillance.
* Experience supporting environmental-compliance programs, facility environmental requirements, or coordination with environmental personnel.
* Associate degree, bachelor’s degree, technical certificate, trade-school training, or other formal education in construction management, facilities management, engineering technology, building systems, industrial technology, environmental technology, or a related field.

**Substitution or Equivalency:**

Relevant education, technical certifications, trade training, or closely related experience may be considered as an equivalency for a portion of the required experience, consistent with company hiring practices and contract requirements.

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

This position requires both fieldwork and computer-based administrative work.

* Periodically required to walk facility grounds and access building mechanical, electrical, utility, storage, and maintenance spaces.
* May be required to use stairs; stand for extended periods during site assessments; bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl as necessary to observe facility conditions.
* May occasionally be required to lift or carry materials, equipment, or documentation associated with facility inspections and site visits.
* Regularly required to use a computer, keyboard, telephone, and other standard office equipment.
* Regularly required to communicate verbally and in writing with customers, Government personnel, service providers, and other stakeholders.
* Normally works in office and field environments. During site visits, the employee may be exposed to varying weather conditions, temperature extremes, construction activity, mechanical equipment, fumes, airborne particles, noise, and other conditions common to facility operations and maintenance environments.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

The Area Facilities Operations Specialist performs field coordination, quality-assurance surveillance, documentation, and technical support. Government personnel retain decision, acceptance, prioritization, approval, and direction authority.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:**

LAUKOA is an Equal Opportunity/VEVRAA federal contractor. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

LAUKOA offers a best-in-class benefits program including medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) program with employer match; paid vacation and sick leave; employer-paid basic life and AD&D insurance; an Employee Assistance Program; and a flexible work environment. Additionally, employees can choose from several voluntary benefits including critical illness coverage; accident insurance; identity theft coverage; pet insurance, and more.

LAUKOA gives preference to internal candidates. If no internal candidate meets our qualifications, external candidates will be given consideration.

6cecf5f18820f3af0133.title: Client Operations Manager, Court Reporting
6cecf5f18820f3af0133.description:
*Can you turn a business growth goal into a resource plan, then lead the team that delivers it?*

*Can you resolve today’s scheduling problem while building the capacity to prevent the next one?*

*Are you a leader…….that personally executes while “being in the mix”?*

CRC Salomon is hiring a **Client Operations Manager, Court Reporting** to lead client scheduling and court reporter resource operations. Reporting directly to Robert Deziel, Chief Operating Officer, you will partner with him on business planning and own departmental execution. That means anticipating demand, developing the team, protecting service quality, and building the resource capacity to support profitable growth.

You must be able to perform both scheduling functions yourself, coach others to do them well, and make sound decisions when client needs, resource availability, and deadlines compete. You are a people leader, driving a team located both locally and remotely throughout the U.S. and internationally.

**To Apply**

Email the following to **Shannon Linville, Hiring Manager**, at **slinville@crcsalomon.com**:

* Your resume and LinkedIn Profile (if you have one)
* A brief video recording answering: **“Why do you believe you would be a strong fit for the Client Operations Manager, Court Reporting role at CRC Salomon?”**

Use any recording method you prefer. Attach the recording or include a link, and confirm that we can access it.

**Email subject:** Client Operations Manager, Court Reporting | Your Name

**About CRC Salomon**

Founded in 1898, CRC Salomon is one of the nation’s first court reporting companies. We serve law firms, courts, government agencies, and businesses through court reporting, transcription, legal video, and remote proceedings. We are strengthening leadership over client scheduling and resource operations to support growth while maintaining the accuracy and dependability our clients expect.

**What you will do**

* **Partner with the COO:** Translate business priorities into operating plans with clear owners and milestones. Bring data, recommendations, progress updates, and specific roadblocks to leadership discussions, then carry agreed decisions through to completion.
* **Lead the department:** Set priorities across client scheduling and resource management. Coach performance, delegate effectively, develop team capability, and hold people accountable for service and execution. Participate in hiring and onboarding.
* **Own client scheduling:** Oversee requests from intake through confirmation and follow-through. Ensure proceeding details, time zones, locations or virtual platforms, client preferences, service requirements, and changes are captured accurately in ReporterBase/RB9.
* **Secure qualified coverage:** Match court reporters, videographers, interpreters, and other resources to assignments based on qualifications, jurisdiction, availability, location, client needs, and cost. Review upcoming work, arrange backups, and resolve gaps before the proceeding.
* **Forecast and recruit ahead:** Connect sales plans and market expansion to staffing and contractor needs over the coming weeks and months. Lead resource recruiting, onboarding, and retention, build reporter relationships, and participate in rate discussions within approved guidelines.
* **Handle escalations and provide coverage:** Lead resolution of client and reporter issues, cancellations, and urgent changes. Communicate clearly until the issue is resolved. Personally handle scheduling or resource assignments when coverage or team development requires it.
* **Coordinate across departments:** Work with Production, Billing, Sales, and case management to ensure accurate job instructions, transcript orders, delivery requirements, and handoffs. Resolve ownership gaps and keep commitments visible.
* **Improve systems and workflows:** Strengthen RB9 use, shared-inbox management, data quality, procedures, and training. Apply practical technology and AI tools where they improve work while protecting accuracy and confidentiality.
* **Manage measurable performance:** Track response and confirmation times, assignment coverage, scheduling accuracy, recruiting progress, resource capacity, and cost. Identify trends, implement corrective action, and report how the department is supporting service, growth, and profitability.

**What we are looking for**

* **People leadership:** Demonstrated success setting expectations, coaching employees, delegating work, and improving team performance. You can point to results delivered through others.
* **Relevant operating experience:** Court reporting or litigation support experience is strongly preferred. We will consider legal-services professionals, including paralegals or legal assistants with substantive leadership experience, and staffing/recruiting operations leaders who demonstrate transferable judgment.
* **Scheduling and resource judgment:** Experience coordinating time-sensitive work, managing competing requirements, and resolving service disruptions. You understand what dependable support means to attorneys and other professional clients.
* **Business ownership:** You connect daily decisions to capacity, cost, client retention, and growth. You turn goals into practical plans and follow through without needing each step prescribed.
* **Credibility and constructive challenge:** You build trust with experienced staff and independent professionals, explain your recommendations clearly, welcome direct feedback, and challenge assumptions with evidence.
* **Technical capability:** Comfort with Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint, plus scheduling or resource-management systems. ReporterBase/RB9 experience is preferred. You use data to make decisions and can evaluate practical uses of AI and automation.

**Why work with us**

Work directly with the COO to shape departmental plans and lead their execution. Apply your experience in an established business expanding its capacity and reach. CRC values teamwork, integrity, clear communication, ownership, and continuous improvement.

**Compensation and benefits**

* Base compensation based on relevant experience and qualifications.
* Discretionary annual bonus potential tied to company performance.
* Potential for an additional role-specific incentive tied to revenue growth and profitability, with structure and terms to be finalized.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with CRC contributing 50% of eligible premiums, including eligible dependent coverage.

Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements, waiting periods, and plan terms. Bonuses and additional incentives are not guaranteed.

Your schedule must support our Monday through Friday Eastern-time operation, with usual business hours of 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. You are responsible for ensuring service coverage, including evenings or weekends when needed.

ba752ca0b5b0834ebccc.title: VP of Sales — Rural & Critical Access Hospitals
ba752ca0b5b0834ebccc.description:
**Location:** Remote, with travel about 25–30% of the time

**Compensation:** $120,000–$140,000 base + uncapped commission · Expected OTE $300,000+ · Future equity conversation for the right candidate

**Reports to:** CEO

Rural hospitals have fought physician shortages for decades, and most of the usual fixes—locums, signing bonuses, endless searches—are expensive and temporary. Something new has changed the picture: nearly 30 states have now created alternative licensure pathways that let experienced, internationally trained physicians practice in the U.S.

WeAreDocs connects those physicians with the rural and Critical Access Hospitals that need them most. We're looking for our VP of Sales: someone who already has the trust of Critical Access Hospital leaders and wants to bring them a genuinely new answer to their hardest staffing problem.

Why this role

* **You bring something new.** This isn't another locums pitch. You'll introduce a workforce model most rural hospital leaders haven't heard of yet, and help them solve shortages for the long term.
* **You build the function.** As our first sales leader, you'll shape the strategy, the process, and eventually the team.
* **Your relationships pay off.** Uncapped commission means the network you've spent years building is rewarded directly.
* **The work matters.** Every partnership you close puts a physician in a community that has been going without one.

About WeAreDocs

WeAreDocs recruits experienced internationally trained physicians and places them with rural and underserved healthcare organizations through state alternative licensure pathways. We handle sourcing, vetting, and guiding physicians through licensure so hospitals get a qualified doctor without carrying the process themselves.

We'll share details on our placements, hospital partnerships, state footprint, and backing with candidates during the interview process.

What you need to bring

This is a specialized role. We need someone who can open doors in the rural hospital community from day one, not someone who would build a network from scratch. You'll need:

* **4+ years selling** staffing, locum tenens, physician recruitment, or healthcare services directly to Critical Access Hospitals or rural healthcare organizations
* **Personal relationships with CAH decision-makers**—CEOs, administrators, HR directors, CMOs, or physician recruitment leaders—that you built yourself and that have stayed with you across roles
* **A track record of generating business** through your own reputation, including after a move between companies
* **Working knowledge of the rural health ecosystem:** NRHA, state Offices of Rural Health, Flex Program coordinators, state rural health and hospital associations, and CAH networks
* **Willingness to travel** regularly for client visits, conferences, and rural healthcare events

Is this you?

**You'll likely thrive here if:**

* CAH executives know your name and take your calls
* You understand how decisions really get made inside an independent rural hospital, and how different that is from a large health system
* You've been a regular at NRHA and state rural health events
* You know rural hospital finances and recruitment challenges well enough to speak credibly about them on a first call

**This probably isn't the right fit if:**

* Your experience is mainly in candidate recruiting rather than selling to hospital leaders
* Your hospital relationships are mostly with large regional or national health systems
* You'd be building a rural hospital network for the first time

What you'll do

* Build and run a national sales strategy focused on Critical Access Hospitals and rural healthcare organizations and other healthcare markets.
* Open conversations with hospital CEOs, administrators, HR directors, CMOs, and physician recruitment leaders
* Own the full sales cycle: outreach, discovery, presentations, proposals, negotiation, and close
* Educate hospital leaders on alternative physician licensure pathways and how our model works in their state
* Build partnerships with state rural health associations, Flex Programs, hospital associations, and rural health networks
* Represent WeAreDocs at NRHA and other rural healthcare conferences
* Work closely with our recruitment and operations teams so every hospital's needs are matched with the right physician
* Keep clear pipeline reporting and forecasts
* Help design the sales process and, as we grow, hire and lead the team

Your first year

* **First 90 days:** Reconnect with your rural hospital network and introduce WeAreDocs, completing at least 20 qualified introductions with hospital decision-makers
* **By month 6:** Grow your pipeline to 30–40 qualified opportunities, sign your first 2–4 partnerships, and establish relationships with key state rural health organizations
* **By month 12:** Secure 6–10 multi-year partnerships from a pipeline of 50–70 qualified opportunities, see physicians placed through your deals, and have a repeatable sales process in place

Compensation and benefits

* **Base salary:** $120,000–$140,000, depending on experience
* **Commission:** Uncapped, paid once the physician starts and the client invoice is collected
* **Expected total compensation:** $300,000+ in a full year at target
* **Ramp support:** A portion of commission is paid at contract signing, with the balance paid once the physician starts and the invoice is collected
* **Equity:** Not part of the initial package; we're open to a future equity conversation with the right candidate
* **Benefits:** health, Dental, PTO, and retirement
* **Travel:** About six industry conferences a year (including NRHA), plus on-site visits with hospital leaders as needed. Expenses fully covered

Final compensation depends on experience, track record, and the strength of your rural hospital network.

How to apply

Send your résumé with short answers to these questions:

* How many years have you sold staffing, locum tenens, recruitment, or healthcare services directly to Critical Access or rural hospitals?
* What rural healthcare services or solutions have you sold?
* Which types of leaders at CAHs do you have personal relationships with (CEO, administrator, HR director, CMO, physician recruitment)? Roughly how many facilities, and in which states or regions?
* Describe a time your relationships generated new business after you changed companies. General terms are fine.
* How have you been involved with NRHA, state rural health associations, Flex Programs, or state Offices of Rural Health?

If we move forward together, we'll talk through specific examples and results in confidence. We respect your current and past agreements: please don't share confidential client information or anything that would conflict with them.

*WeAreDocs is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and evaluate applicants on experience, results, and alignment with our mission.*

Pay: Up to $300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

727ed354f7f5e773361c.title: Head of Revenue Operations
727ed354f7f5e773361c.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

**About the Role**

As Head of Revenue Operations, you will build, optimize, and scale the operational, data, and technology foundation across our entire go-to-market organization—including Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Partnerships. Reporting directly to executive leadership, your mission is to transform our systems, billing infrastructure, reporting, and GTM strategy into a clear, high-performing growth engine.

You will lead a small but high-impact RevOps team (2 direct reports) while personally owning the architecture and execution of our RevTech stack (including HubSpot and Chargebee), lead management, funnel optimization, enablement and ramp, and AI deployment. This is not a traditional admin role—we are looking for a builder, strategic systems architect, and AI-forward operator who rationalizes existing tools before adding new ones, replaces manual reporting with automated signal, and shortens new-hire time-to-productivity as a core business metric.

  

*This role is 100% remote and available to US-based candidates.*

  

**You Are**

* **An Operational Builder & AI-Forward Architect:** Highly organized and system-minded, you thrive on taking complex, disconnected processes and building simple, scalable workflows. You actively identify, test, and deploy AI tools and automated knowledge systems to eliminate manual work and boost team productivity.
* **A Strategic Systems Thinker:** You look beyond basic CRM administration to understand broader business goals, connecting executive priorities to billing infrastructure, tech stack rationalization, and RevOps strategy.
* **A Hands-On Problem Solver:** You balance executive strategy with technical execution—equally comfortable presenting to leadership or personally building automations, forecasting models, and CRM workflows.
* **A Growth & Ramp Driver:** You view new-hire time-to-productivity as a business metric, using automated measurement, early success signals, and modern systems to ramp revenue teams faster.
* **A Collaborative Leader:** You manage, mentor, and elevate a team of RevOps professionals while bridging the gap between technical data systems and business leadership to align GTM operations.

  

**You Will**

* **Own Revenue Systems, Billing Infrastructure & AI Innovation:** Lead full ownership and architecture of core revenue systems (HubSpot, Chargebee, and broader RevTech). Continuously inspect, consolidate, and optimize current platforms before evaluating new spend. Build advanced automation workflows across Marketing, Sales, CS, Finance, and Partnerships, and deploy AI tools (such as living AI knowledge bases/Claude skills libraries) to streamline operations.
* **Drive Enablement, Ramp & Team Productivity:** Own new-hire ramp time with a clear, measurable path to reduction. Design onboarding, coaching, and exception-based reporting workflows that run through systems rather than headcount. Partner with Sales leadership on structural changes (comp design, team placement) that raise pipeline productivity per rep.
* **Optimize Funnel Performance & Revenue Intelligence:** Diagnose pipeline leaks and conversion bottlenecks across all channels. Build executive dashboards, forecasting models, and predictive analytics to improve speed-to-lead, decision-maker contact rates, expansion efficiency, and retention outcomes. Ground all recommendations in data first.
* **Lead Data Strategy & Governance:** Define how data is captured, structured, and managed across the customer lifecycle, improving CRM hygiene, billing accuracy, reporting integrity, and system interoperability.
* **Manage & Develop the RevOps Team:** Lead, hire, and mentor 2 direct reports. Build a culture of innovation, systems thinking, accountability, and technical excellence, raising team competency across AI, automation, and systems architecture.
* **Partner Cross-Functionally:** Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, CS, Finance, Product, and Executive Leadership to support product-led growth (PLG) motions, upgrade paths, monetization strategies, and long-term GTM infrastructure.

  

**You Have**

**Must Have**

* **RevOps Leadership Experience:** 5–8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Systems, or Revenue Enablement, with proven experience leading teams or major strategic initiatives.
* **Systems & Tech Stack Mastery:** Deep expertise configuring and managing HubSpot, along with strong experience in billing/subscription management platforms (Chargebee or similar) and operational architecture.
* **AI & Automation Curiosity:** Hands-on track record implementing modern automation tools and proactive experience deploying AI solutions (including AI-powered knowledge or enablement systems).
* **Enablement & Ramp Ownership:** Experience owning, measuring, or influencing new-hire ramp time and onboarding outcomes as core operational metrics.
* **Data & Analytics Proficiency:** Strong analytical background with direct experience querying raw data, building forecasting models, and designing board-level/executive dashboards (SQL, BI tools, or advanced analytics platforms).
* **Stack Rationalization Skills:** Proven track record evaluating, consolidating, or replacing major GTM and business software platforms.

  

**Nice to Have**

* **Billing Operations:** Direct experience with Chargebee, subscription management, and revenue recognition workflows.
* **Product-Led Growth (PLG):** Experience supporting PLG motions, automated upgrade paths, and expansion loops.
* **Early-Stage / High-Growth Scaling:** Experience scaling a RevOps function in a fast-growing SaaS tech company.
* **Multi-Segment GTM:** Background supporting multi-segment environments (SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise).
* **Marketing Attribution & Demand Gen:** Deep understanding of marketing attribution models and demand generation tech stacks.

  

**Interview Process**

* **Initial Screen:** 30 min with the Lead Recruiter
* **Hiring Manager Interview:** 45 min with the CRO
* **Problem Solving Interview & Executive interview :** 60 min with the Director of People & 45 min with the CEO
* **Case Study Presentation:** 60 min with the CRO & CFO

  

**We Offer**

* 100% remote work environment
* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance within 30 days (100% employer-paid medical)
* Equity package
* Flexible PTO with a 15-day minimum
* Generous Parental Leave
* FSA and HSA options
* 401(k)
* Growth & Wellness Stipend
* WFH Equipment stipend
* Chance to work with the latest technology and AI tools
* A collaborative, high-ownership culture with clear opportunities for career growth

**Why Join Steer?**  
  
At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you'll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.  
  
  
  
  
We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

52558849debb632aea8f.title: Front Desk Receptionist & Showroom Coordinator
52558849debb632aea8f.description:
**Front Desk Receptionist & Showroom Coordinator**

**Company:** Master Design Cabinetry

**Position: Front Desk Receptionist & Showroom Coordinator**

**Reports To:** Accounting Administrator

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Schedule: Monday through Friday,** 7:30 AM – 4:30 PM

**Location: On-site in Honey Brook, PA**

**Visit our website to learn about us:**

**About Master Design Cabinetry**

At Master Design Cabinetry, we believe exceptional living spaces start with purposeful design and authentic craftsmanship. For nearly two decades, our team of dedicated cabinet designers and craftsmen has partnered with homeowners, architects, interior designers, builders, and renovators to build custom luxury cabinetry tailored to each lifestyle.

Our showroom is where dreams begin to take shape. We are looking for a warm, organized, and proactive **Front Desk Receptionist & Showroom Coordinator** to be the welcoming face and operational backbone of our front office.

**Position Overview**

As our Front Desk Receptionist & Showroom Coordinator, you set the tone for every client who walks through our doors or calls our office. In this role, you will balance warm hospitality with administrative efficiency. You will welcome homeowners, builders, and designers while keeping our showroom client-ready, managing sample inventories, and supporting our team as they host their own guests.

If you thrive in hospitality and take pride in keeping day-to-day operations polished and organized, we would love to meet you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Client Hospitality & Showroom Ambassador:**
* Warmly welcome visiting homeowners, interior designers, builders, renovators, and other trade professionals.
* Prepare meeting spaces before appointments and welcome guests with refreshments (including coffee, beverages, and light snacks such as small charcuterie boards).
* Ensure the foyer, showroom, client consultation areas, and front desk spaces remain immaculate, organized, and inviting.
* **Communication & Call Management:**
* Answer, screen, and route incoming calls with warmth, clarity, and professionalism; take detailed messages and provide general information to clients, vendors, and team members.
* Monitor the general office email inbox and direct inquiries to the appropriate team members.
* **Showroom Sample & Inventory Management:**
* Maintain, organize, and track our showroom sample library (paint, stain, and door samples) to ensure availability and accuracy.
* Create and print product labels using Avery label software.
* Prepare, package, and ship sample orders to customers, as well as reorder sample inventory as needed.
* **Design, Administrative & Event Support:**
* Manage the showroom appointment calendar, and assist designers with client scheduling, basic data entry, and filing.
* Support the designated event coordinator with company events, customer appreciation events, showroom open houses, training sessions, and team gatherings.
* **Mail, Deliveries & Office Coordination:**
* Receive, log, sort, and distribute incoming mail, vendor deliveries, material samples, and packages; prepare outgoing mail and coordinate courier pickups.
* Monitor and maintain inventory of front-office supplies and hospitality items, reordering essentials before they run out.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Experience:** 1–3 years of front desk, receptionist, administrative assistant, or customer hospitality experience (prior exposure to interior design, custom construction, showroom environments, or shipping/inventory management is a plus).
* **Interpersonal Polish:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with an approachable, professional demeanor.
* **Attention to Detail:** High organizational ability, strong follow-through, and proactive problem-solving instincts.
* **Tech-Savvy:** Comfortable with standard office equipment and technology. Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams) is required. Familiarity with Avery labeling software and scheduling/CRM tools (or the ability to quickly learn them) is preferred.
* **Reliability:** Punctual, dependable, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively while balancing multiple priorities in a dynamic office setting.
* **Physical Requirements:** Ability to sit, stand, and walk throughout the workday. Ability to occasionally lift and move packages or sample materials up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Why You’ll Love Working With Us**

* **Predictable Schedule:** Reliable Monday through Friday daytime.
* **Inspiring Environment:** Work alongside passionate craftsmen and designers in a beautiful, creative setting.
* **Supportive Culture:** A collaborative, close-knit team where your organization and contributions are genuinely valued.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Pay Rate:** $18.00–$22.00 per hour *(Commensurate with experience)*
* **Benefits Package:**
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays
* Health, dental, and vision insurance options

**How to Apply**

Ready to become the first impression of Master Design Cabinetry? We would love to hear from you!

* **Email:** Submit your resume and a brief introductory note to **amos@masterdesigncabinetry.com**.
* **Subject Line:** *Application: Front Desk Receptionist – [Your Full Name]*
* **In-Person Option:** You are welcome to drop off your resume at our showroom (104 Reservoir Rd, Honey Brook, PA 19344) Monday through Friday between 8:30 AM and 4:00 PM.

Pay: $18.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and highly organized **Administrative Coordinator / Front Desk & Patient Experience Specialist** to join our growing medical spa team. This intermediate-level role is ideal for a polished professional who understands the medical spa environment, can confidently discuss services with prospective and existing clients, and is skilled at creating a seamless, high-touch client experience.

The ideal candidate will combine strong administrative judgment with excellent communication and consultative sales skills. This position will serve as a key point of contact for the practice, managing client inquiries, appointments, treatment coordination, follow-ups, CRM/EMR documentation, and daily administrative workflows.

This role is well suited for someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable working independently, and able to represent our brand with warmth, confidence, and professionalism.

**Responsibilities**

-Serve as a knowledgeable and professional point of contact for current and prospective clients by phone, email, text, and other communication platforms. Educate clients on medical spa services, treatment processes, memberships, policies, and preparation or aftercare guidelines within the scope of the role.

-Respond to inquiries, identify client needs, schedule consultations and appointments, and support lead conversion through timely, consultative follow-up. Follow up with leads regarding consultations, memberships, packages, retail opportunities, and treatment inquiries.

-Manage scheduling workflows, including confirmations, rescheduling, cancellations, waitlists, late arrivals, and no-shows. Coordinate communication between clients, providers, and team members to ensure efficient daily operations.

-Maintain and consistently work toward the practice’s established close-rate and booking-conversion goals for new leads, using timely follow-up, knowledgeable service recommendations, and professional communication to convert inquiries into consultations and appointments.

-Maintain accurate client records, communication notes, appointment details, and follow-up tasks within the CRM and EMR. Support forms, intake processes, reminders, payment coordination, and general administrative organization.

-Protect client privacy and follow HIPAA, confidentiality, documentation, and internal compliance standards. Identify opportunities to improve scheduling efficiency, client communication, client retention, and overall practice operations.

**Qualifications**

-Previous experience in a medical spa, aesthetics, dermatology, plastic surgery, wellness, healthcare administration, luxury service, or hospitality environment, along with working knowledge of common medical spa services such as injectables, laser treatments, skin rejuvenation, and wellness treatments.

-Experience with consultative sales, lead follow-up, appointment conversion, memberships/ packages. Ability to discuss services accurately and professionally without providing medical advice outside the scope of the role.

-Strong CRM and EMR experience, including client documentation, task management, scheduling, follow-up workflows, and record maintenance.

-Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a warm, polished, and professional phone presence. Must be comfortable communicating with a wide range of clients and representing a premium medical spa brand.

-Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, maintain accuracy, and follow through consistently.

-Professional judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive client information appropriately. Must be comfortable learning and navigating multiple software systems, scheduling platforms, phone systems, messaging tools, and digital workflows.

**Schedule**

*Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday*

*10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Pacific Time*

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is more than a traditional receptionist. The successful candidate will be a proactive administrative partner who understands the client journey, communicates with confidence, supports revenue-generating opportunities, and helps ensure the practice operates smoothly.

If you are knowledgeable about medical spa services, comfortable with CRM and EMR systems, skilled at client communication and follow-up, and passionate about delivering an exceptional experience, we would love to hear from you.

Join our team and help clients feel informed, welcomed, and confident throughout their wellness and aesthetic journey.

Pay: $10.00 - $20.00 per hour

Expected hours: 24.0 – 32.0 per week

Work Location: Remote
