a307fdf5f89550e98631.description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**AECOM** is seeking a highly qualified, **Customer Support Manager** to lead the CTrides customer support center. This role will primarily be a remote position, with the caveat that training will be in person, and the team may be required to attend in person meetings and trainings in the office and the remote work is subject to change.

The role centers on three things: developing the team, controlling the quality of what customers get, and making the operation work better over time. The Customer Support Manager is accountable for the full customer experience, including training, quality, procedures, scheduling, and service improvement. The goal is a support operation that runs efficiently, meets project and customer expectations, and builds customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention.

The successful candidate will lead the Customer Support team and hold it to clear standards for service quality and accountability. The selected individual will be the point of contact for onboarding and ongoing training so staff know the policies, procedures, and systems and handle customers well.

The job responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to:

* Coach and mentor each team member through regular one-on-ones, performance feedback, and clear development goals. Use QA findings and performance data to decide where training and coaching are needed most.
* Prepare and lead team meetings, training sessions, performance reviews, and operational updates. Run a structured QA program that reviews a consistent sample of calls, emails, chats, web inquiries, and case documentation against defined service standards.
* Maintain the QA scorecard and standards and hold calibration sessions so reviewers score consistently. Review automated responses, including the AI agent and chat automation, and flag errors and gaps for correction.
* Track trends in QA scores, customer feedback, and performance metrics, and report findings to leadership. Use what QA turns up to fix problems, whether that means coaching someone, updating training, or correcting the knowledge base.
* Work with the Program Director to identify ways to improve support tools, workflows, and automated customer responses, and help set priorities for changes. Give input and help test during system changes and rollouts, and train staff on what’s different afterward.
* Own the content of the knowledge base, standard operating procedures, job aids, FAQs, and training materials, and keep it accurate and current. Monitor how the AI agent and chat automation perform with customers and identify where they fall short.
* Use Zendesk, databases, reporting tools, and standard office software to track service levels, workload, and quality results. Build a strong understanding of Connecticut transportation programs, services, routes, schedules, and mobility resources. Make sure staff know CTrides policies, practices, and service standards, including how to handle service alerts and disruptions.
* Work with transportation providers, partners, and stakeholders to gather, verify, and keep current route, schedule, and service information. Take ownership of escalated and complex customer issues, see them through to resolution, and communicate outcomes clearly to customers and stakeholders.
* Support representatives with day-to-day challenges. Provide accurate, courteous support by phone, email, web platforms, and other channels, and step in as a representative when needed.
* Build and maintain team schedules with enough staffing to cover service.
* Manage workload and resources, and monitor attendance, time-off requests, and schedule changes to protect service levels. Keep accurate records of customer interactions, resolutions, quality reviews, and departmental activity.

  
**Qualifications**

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

* BA/BS + 6 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
* Valid U.S Driver's License and as a condition of employment, must pass AECOM's Motor Vehicle Records Review

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* 6 years of customer service experience, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or management role leading a customer support team
* Experience helping improve support tools, workflows, or knowledge content
* Demonstrated experience training, coaching, and developing staff, including running onboarding programs
* Demonstrated experience running QA reviews and using the results to improve coaching and processes
* Experience with customer support platforms such as Zendesk or similar ticketing and case management systems
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
* Proven experience using management methods and techniques
* Familiarity with AI agents or chat automation in a customer service setting.
* Awareness of current customer service technology, trends, and applications

  
**Additional Information**  

* Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position
* Relocation assistance is not available
* Primarily weekday hours. Some weekend work required to support service coverage, QA, and training
* Primarily a general office environment, with occasional travel to project or client sites
* Ability to lift up to 30 lbs

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

f361fc27a24730f7908b.title: Senior Director, Risk Management & Insurance (Remote)
f361fc27a24730f7908b.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

The Senior Director, Risk Management & Construction Risk serves as the Company's senior risk leader and trusted advisor to executive leadership. This role is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive risk management strategy that supports the Company's operational, financial, and growth objectives.  
  
The Senior Director provides enterprise-wide leadership across risk management, insurance, surety, claims, contractual risk transfer, alternative risk financing, and loss prevention. Working closely with Operations, Preconstruction, Safety, Fleet, Finance, Human Resources, and Legal, this leader ensures risk management is integrated into key business decisions and project execution strategies.  
  
This position will play a critical role in strengthening the Company's risk profile, enhancing surety capacity, reducing total cost of risk, and evaluating sophisticated risk financing solutions, including captive insurance and self-insurance structures.  
  
This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

Enterprise Risk Management & Strategic Leadership:

* Lead and continuously enhance the Company's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership and the Board on enterprise, operational, financial, contractual, and emerging risks.
* Develop and maintain enterprise risk assessments, risk registers, and key risk indicators (KRIs).
* Establish executive-level risk reporting and dashboards that support informed decision-making.
* Facilitate enterprise risk reviews and strategic planning discussions across business functions.
* Identify and evaluate emerging risks impacting construction operations, workforce planning, project delivery, market conditions, cybersecurity, environmental exposures, and regulatory compliance.
* Participate in major business initiatives, acquisitions, geographic expansion opportunities, and strategic investments to provide risk-based guidance.

Construction Risk & Operational Partnership:

* Partner closely with Operations and Preconstruction teams to assess risk associated with project pursuits and execution.
* Support go/no-go decisions through evaluation of project-specific risks, contract structures, delivery methods, labor availability, financial exposure, and owner qualifications.
* Assist project leadership teams in identifying and managing operational risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop risk assessment protocols for large, complex, or non-traditional projects.
* Participate in strategic reviews of major projects and emerging operational exposures.

Insurance Program Leadership:

* Provide executive oversight of all corporate and project-specific insurance programs, including:
  + General Liability
  + Workers' Compensation
  + Commercial Automobile
  + Umbrella and Excess Liability
  + Builder's Risk
  + Professional Liability
  + Pollution Liability
  + Property Insurance
  + Cyber Liability
  + Executive Liability Coverages
* Lead annual insurance renewals and long-term insurance strategy development.
* Negotiate coverage structures, retentions, limits, and pricing with brokers and insurance carriers.
* Maintain strong relationships with insurers, brokers, and underwriting partners.
* Evaluate emerging insurance solutions and recommend program enhancements.
* Benchmark insurance programs against industry peers and best practices.
* Oversee insurance audits and ensure accurate reporting and premium allocations.
* Manage project-specific insurance placements and controlled insurance programs (OCIPs/CCIPs) when applicable.

Alternative Risk Financing & Captive Strategy:

* Lead the evaluation and development of alternative risk financing strategies.
* Conduct feasibility studies related to captive insurance, self-insurance, large deductible programs, and other risk-retention structures.
* Develop financial models evaluating Total Cost of Risk (TCOR), reserve requirements, and long-term financial impact.
* Partner with actuaries, captive managers, legal counsel, auditors, and tax advisors to develop recommendations.
* Present business cases and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Oversee implementation and governance of approved alternative risk financing programs.

Surety Program Management:

* Lead the Company's surety bonding strategy and program management.
* Maintain and strengthen relationships with surety companies, brokers, and underwriters.
* Monitor aggregate bonding capacity and ensure alignment with backlog and growth objectives.
* Coordinate financial and operational reporting for surety partners.
* Negotiate bond terms, rates, collateral requirements, and program structures.
* Provide executive leadership with forecasting and analyses regarding surety capacity and future project opportunities.

Claims Management & Loss Reduction:

* Provide strategic oversight of all workers' compensation, liability, builder's risk, automobile, environmental, and professional liability claims.
* Establish claims management practices that reduce claim frequency, severity, and overall cost.
* Manage complex, high-severity, and litigated claims in partnership with legal counsel and third-party administrators.
* Monitor claim development, reserve adequacy, and litigation strategy.
* Analyze loss trends and identify opportunities for operational improvements and enhanced loss prevention.
* Report significant claims activity and risk exposures to executive leadership.

Contract Risk Transfer & Legal Partnership:

* Oversee review and negotiation of risk-related provisions within:
  + Construction contracts
  + Subcontracts
  + Joint venture agreements
  + Design agreements
  + Professional service agreements
  + Vendor contracts
  + Equipment leases
  + Real estate development agreements
* Partner with Legal and Operations teams to negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance, warranty, and dispute resolution provisions.
* Establish and maintain company-wide contractual risk standards and review processes.
* Ensure contractual obligations align with insurance coverage and corporate risk tolerance.

Safety, Fleet & Loss Prevention Partnership:

* Partner with Safety and Fleet leadership to develop enterprise-wide loss reduction strategies.
* Utilize claims and operational data to identify trends and target high-risk activities.
* Support initiatives designed to reduce workers' compensation, general liability, and fleet-related losses.
* Review and monitor key performance indicators, including:
  + Experience Modification Rate (EMR)
  + OSHA metrics
  + Incident rates
  + Vehicle accident trends
  + Near-miss reporting
  + Safety audit results
* Quantify and communicate the financial impact of safety and risk-control initiatives.
* Present integrated Risk, Safety, and Fleet performance reports to executive leadership.

Leadership & Team Development:

* Build and lead a high-performing risk management organization.
* Mentor and develop team members while establishing a strong succession pipeline.
* Foster a collaborative culture focused on continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and business partnership.
* Champion a proactive risk culture throughout the organization.
* Serve as the organization's primary resource for risk management education and awareness.

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Insurance, Finance, Business Administration, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field required.
* MBA, Master's Degree in Risk Management, or related advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise risk management, project risk, construction risk, insurance, or operational risk within EPC, industrial construction, energy, infrastructure, or related sectors.
* Significant experience managing large-scale insurance and risk financing programs.
* Demonstrated success overseeing surety programs supporting large and complex construction projects.
* Experience with captive insurance, self-insurance, large deductible programs, or alternative risk financing structures strongly preferred.
* Proven track record managing complex claims and litigation matters.
* Experience partnering directly with executive leadership teams and Boards of Directors.
* Strong understanding of construction operations, project delivery methods, and contractual risk environments.

**Preferred Professional Certifications:**

* CPCU (Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter)
* CRM (Certified Risk Manager)
* ARM (Associate in Risk Management)
* CRIS (Construction Risk and Insurance Specialist)
* ACI (Associate in Captive Insurance)

**Key Competencies:**
---------------------

* Strategic Leadership & Business Acumen
* Enterprise Risk Management
* Construction Operations Knowledge
* Insurance & Alternative Risk Financing Expertise
* Surety & Contract Risk Management
* Financial Analysis & Total Cost of Risk Modeling
* Executive Communication & Board Presentation Skills
* Negotiation & Relationship Management
* Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence
* Data Analytics & Decision-Making
* Team Development & Organizational Leadership

b9004622531cdbd4d569.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

The Senior Director, Risk Management & Construction Risk serves as the Company's senior risk leader and trusted advisor to executive leadership. This role is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive risk management strategy that supports the Company's operational, financial, and growth objectives.  
  
The Senior Director provides enterprise-wide leadership across risk management, insurance, surety, claims, contractual risk transfer, alternative risk financing, and loss prevention. Working closely with Operations, Preconstruction, Safety, Fleet, Finance, Human Resources, and Legal, this leader ensures risk management is integrated into key business decisions and project execution strategies.  
  
This position will play a critical role in strengthening the Company's risk profile, enhancing surety capacity, reducing total cost of risk, and evaluating sophisticated risk financing solutions, including captive insurance and self-insurance structures.  
  
This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

Enterprise Risk Management & Strategic Leadership:

* Lead and continuously enhance the Company's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership and the Board on enterprise, operational, financial, contractual, and emerging risks.
* Develop and maintain enterprise risk assessments, risk registers, and key risk indicators (KRIs).
* Establish executive-level risk reporting and dashboards that support informed decision-making.
* Facilitate enterprise risk reviews and strategic planning discussions across business functions.
* Identify and evaluate emerging risks impacting construction operations, workforce planning, project delivery, market conditions, cybersecurity, environmental exposures, and regulatory compliance.
* Participate in major business initiatives, acquisitions, geographic expansion opportunities, and strategic investments to provide risk-based guidance.

Construction Risk & Operational Partnership:

* Partner closely with Operations and Preconstruction teams to assess risk associated with project pursuits and execution.
* Support go/no-go decisions through evaluation of project-specific risks, contract structures, delivery methods, labor availability, financial exposure, and owner qualifications.
* Assist project leadership teams in identifying and managing operational risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop risk assessment protocols for large, complex, or non-traditional projects.
* Participate in strategic reviews of major projects and emerging operational exposures.

Insurance Program Leadership:

* Provide executive oversight of all corporate and project-specific insurance programs, including:
  + General Liability
  + Workers' Compensation
  + Commercial Automobile
  + Umbrella and Excess Liability
  + Builder's Risk
  + Professional Liability
  + Pollution Liability
  + Property Insurance
  + Cyber Liability
  + Executive Liability Coverages
* Lead annual insurance renewals and long-term insurance strategy development.
* Negotiate coverage structures, retentions, limits, and pricing with brokers and insurance carriers.
* Maintain strong relationships with insurers, brokers, and underwriting partners.
* Evaluate emerging insurance solutions and recommend program enhancements.
* Benchmark insurance programs against industry peers and best practices.
* Oversee insurance audits and ensure accurate reporting and premium allocations.
* Manage project-specific insurance placements and controlled insurance programs (OCIPs/CCIPs) when applicable.

Alternative Risk Financing & Captive Strategy:

* Lead the evaluation and development of alternative risk financing strategies.
* Conduct feasibility studies related to captive insurance, self-insurance, large deductible programs, and other risk-retention structures.
* Develop financial models evaluating Total Cost of Risk (TCOR), reserve requirements, and long-term financial impact.
* Partner with actuaries, captive managers, legal counsel, auditors, and tax advisors to develop recommendations.
* Present business cases and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Oversee implementation and governance of approved alternative risk financing programs.

Surety Program Management:

* Lead the Company's surety bonding strategy and program management.
* Maintain and strengthen relationships with surety companies, brokers, and underwriters.
* Monitor aggregate bonding capacity and ensure alignment with backlog and growth objectives.
* Coordinate financial and operational reporting for surety partners.
* Negotiate bond terms, rates, collateral requirements, and program structures.
* Provide executive leadership with forecasting and analyses regarding surety capacity and future project opportunities.

Claims Management & Loss Reduction:

* Provide strategic oversight of all workers' compensation, liability, builder's risk, automobile, environmental, and professional liability claims.
* Establish claims management practices that reduce claim frequency, severity, and overall cost.
* Manage complex, high-severity, and litigated claims in partnership with legal counsel and third-party administrators.
* Monitor claim development, reserve adequacy, and litigation strategy.
* Analyze loss trends and identify opportunities for operational improvements and enhanced loss prevention.
* Report significant claims activity and risk exposures to executive leadership.

Contract Risk Transfer & Legal Partnership:

* Oversee review and negotiation of risk-related provisions within:
  + Construction contracts
  + Subcontracts
  + Joint venture agreements
  + Design agreements
  + Professional service agreements
  + Vendor contracts
  + Equipment leases
  + Real estate development agreements
* Partner with Legal and Operations teams to negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance, warranty, and dispute resolution provisions.
* Establish and maintain company-wide contractual risk standards and review processes.
* Ensure contractual obligations align with insurance coverage and corporate risk tolerance.

Safety, Fleet & Loss Prevention Partnership:

* Partner with Safety and Fleet leadership to develop enterprise-wide loss reduction strategies.
* Utilize claims and operational data to identify trends and target high-risk activities.
* Support initiatives designed to reduce workers' compensation, general liability, and fleet-related losses.
* Review and monitor key performance indicators, including:
  + Experience Modification Rate (EMR)
  + OSHA metrics
  + Incident rates
  + Vehicle accident trends
  + Near-miss reporting
  + Safety audit results
* Quantify and communicate the financial impact of safety and risk-control initiatives.
* Present integrated Risk, Safety, and Fleet performance reports to executive leadership.

Leadership & Team Development:

* Build and lead a high-performing risk management organization.
* Mentor and develop team members while establishing a strong succession pipeline.
* Foster a collaborative culture focused on continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and business partnership.
* Champion a proactive risk culture throughout the organization.
* Serve as the organization's primary resource for risk management education and awareness.

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Insurance, Finance, Business Administration, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field required.
* MBA, Master's Degree in Risk Management, or related advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise risk management, project risk, construction risk, insurance, or operational risk within EPC, industrial construction, energy, infrastructure, or related sectors.
* Significant experience managing large-scale insurance and risk financing programs.
* Demonstrated success overseeing surety programs supporting large and complex construction projects.
* Experience with captive insurance, self-insurance, large deductible programs, or alternative risk financing structures strongly preferred.
* Proven track record managing complex claims and litigation matters.
* Experience partnering directly with executive leadership teams and Boards of Directors.
* Strong understanding of construction operations, project delivery methods, and contractual risk environments.

**Preferred Professional Certifications:**

* CPCU (Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter)
* CRM (Certified Risk Manager)

* ACI (Associate in Captive Insurance)

**Key Competencies:**

Senior Growth Marketing Specialist

STI Federal is seeking a mission-driven **Senior Growth Marketing Specialist** to serve as the marketing engine of our federal growth strategy. Partnering with Business Development and Capture, this role builds visibility with agencies, primes, and teaming partners and converts it into qualified pipeline.

**Who We Are & What We Do…**

At STI Federal, we drive growth through strategic government contracting, fulfilling our mission to support the Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians. Our company reinvests 100% of its profits into tribal businesses or community programs, enhancing the well-being of over 52,000 tribal citizens. Our work empowers federal agencies and strengthens some of the nation’s most critical initiatives, while fostering opportunities for skilled professionals to make a meaningful impact.

**What You’ll Do…**

**Key Responsibilities & Expected Outcomes**

**Growth Strategy & Business Development Alignment**

* Partner with Business Development and Capture leadership to build and execute an annual growth marketing plan aligned to target agencies, priority pursuits, contract vehicles, and the recompete calendar.
* Translate the opportunity pipeline into account-based campaigns aimed at specific agency program offices, contracting activities, OSDBU offices, and large-prime teaming partners.
* Position STI Federal’s tribally owned status, socioeconomic designations, and differentiators in market-facing messaging that supports set-aside, direct-award, and teaming strategies where applicable.
* Participate in BD pipeline reviews to keep marketing priorities synchronized with capture timelines.

**Conference, Trade Show & Industry Event Marketing**

* Build and manage the annual event calendar (e.g., AFCEA, NDIA, AUSA, ACT-IAC, agency industry days, OSDBU matchmaking events, and tribal business forums), recommending where to attend, exhibit, or sponsor based on pipeline alignment and expected return.
* Represent and market STI Federal at conferences, trade shows, industry days, and matchmaking sessions: staff the booth, deliver the company pitch, and initiate conversations with government buyers, prime contractors, and prospective teaming partners.
* Drive pre-event targeting: identify priority attendees, agency speakers, and exhibiting primes; secure meetings for BD and executive leadership; and run pre-show LinkedIn and email outreach.
* Capture, qualify, and log all event leads and contacts in the CRM within 48 hours of each event, and coordinate disciplined post-event follow-up with Business Development.
* Measure and report event performance (meetings secured, qualified contacts, teaming conversations initiated, and opportunities influenced) to inform future event investment decisions.

**Booth, Exhibit & Collateral Operations**

* Own end-to-end exhibit execution: registration, booth space selection, exhibitor deadlines, shipping and drayage, electrical and internet orders, and on-site setup and teardown.
* Order, design, and maintain conference booth materials and inventory, including backdrops, banners, table throws, displays, signage, lead-capture tools, and branded promotional items, in alignment with brand standards.
* Produce event-ready collateral, including capability statements, agency-specific one-pagers, contract vehicle sheets, and leave-behinds tailored to each event’s audience.
* Manage event and sponsorship budgets and vendors, and prepare booth staff with target lists and talking points so every representative engages on message.
* Ensure promotional items, hospitality, and event engagement with government personnel comply with federal ethics and gift rules.

**Capture & Proposal Marketing Support**

* Maintain the capability statement library, past performance write-ups, and company boilerplate used across capture, proposals, RFIs, and sources sought responses.
* Produce proposal graphics, win-theme visuals, and branded templates in partnership with the proposal team.

**Digital Presence & Content**

* Maintain the corporate website as an authoritative “briefing room” communicating capabilities, NAICS codes, contract vehicles, and past performance, with full ADA and Section 508 compliance.
* Translate complex technical services into mission-focused web content, capability sheets, whitepapers, newsletters, and proof points in partnership with SMEs and leadership.
* Lead the company’s LinkedIn presence and executive thought-leadership campaigns, and amplify STI Federal’s event presence before, during, and after each conference.

**Pipeline Attribution & Performance**

* Track and report marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline with BD, tying campaigns and events to opportunity outcomes.
* Route inbound agency and teaming inquiries to Business Development, and ensure no sensitive BD, capture, or nonpublic information enters public-facing materials.

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities for Success**

* Working knowledge of the federal acquisition lifecycle, from sources sought through award and recompete, and how marketing accelerates each stage.
* Confident, polished in-person presence; able to engage senior government officials, prime contractor executives, and small business liaisons on the conference floor.

* Strong project and vendor management skills, with a collaborative approach to working alongside BD, SMEs, and leadership.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), CMS and analytics tools, and design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva); able to convert technical concepts into clear, persuasive content.
* Demonstrates commitment to STI Federal’s core values and excels in a collaborative team environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in communications, Marketing, Digital Media, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**Experience:**

* 5+ years of marketing experience in a business-to-government (B2G) or federal contracting environment supporting business development or growth.
* Hands-on experience planning and executing conferences and trade shows, including booth logistics, materials ordering, and vendor management.
* Experience managing corporate websites and producing capability-based content.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Advanced degree or certifications in marketing, digital marketing, or related specialties; APMP certification a plus.

**Experience:**

* Experience marketing for a tribally owned, 8(a), or other small business federal contractor.
* Experience with federal market intelligence platforms (e.g., GovWin IQ, Bloomberg Government, HigherGov).
* Experience producing proposal graphics or supporting proposal operations.

**Work Environment**

* **Environment:** Climate-controlled office or remote setting, with up to 25% domestic travel to conferences and industry events, including occasional evenings and weekends.

* **Physical Requirements:** Ability to stand for extended periods and lift booth materials up to 40 lbs, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**STI Federal is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.** We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. Qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, disability, ethnicity/race, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or veteran status. Native American preference applies when candidates meet qualifications equally.

STI Federal participates in the Electronic Employment Verification Program. Learn more about E-Verify.

**Company Description**

**Who We Are:**

Circle Logistics is a 3rd party logistics firm focused on delivering our three core promises to our customers: No Fail Service, Personalized Communication, and Innovative Solutions. We leverage our technology, industry experience, and employee ingenuity to develop industry-leading transportation solutions. We have been in business for 10 plus years and have grown into a half-billion-dollar company, from starting as just a handful of people with Entrepreneurial Spirit as their foundation. Our story is one of resiliency and innovation that has led us to grow to over 500 employees in a booming transportation industry, that never takes a night off.

 **Job Description**

**What We Are Looking For:**

As a team we are looking for driven people who have **GRIT, TENACITY & A DESIRE TO WIN!**

**Track & Trace Representative - Taylor, MI**

As Track & Trace Representative, you will work in a fast-paced environment coordinating our day-to-day shipments and supporting the efforts of our office by providing visibility and maintaining accurate documentation for all loads. The key responsibilities of this role are to provide clear and concise communication, troubleshoot customer concerns, and proactively monitor the movement of freight to ensure customer satisfaction.

**Responsibilities:**

* Enter new load orders into our proprietary web-based software
* Initiate “check calls” to track and trace drivers on all pickups and deliveries
* Communicate internal correspondence with drivers to ensure accurate documentation
* Closely monitor freight via multiple detailed websites to ensure accurate delivery times and to notify customers of potential delays
* Maintain and collect proper paperwork for each shipment
* Work cooperatively with Sales and Dispatch to provide solutions for customers’ needs and resolve issues
* Maintain an outbound call volume of 100 calls per day

  
**Qualifications**

**Skills/Abilities:**

* 1-3 years of work experience in customer service, operations, data entry, call center, dispatch or logistics
* Must have strong attention to detail
* Ability to prioritize, balance, and organize information while completing multiple tasks.
* Above average proficiency in Google Drive and Microsoft Suite
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent teamwork skills

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* Associate's degree preferred
* Call center experience is a bonus

**Benefits:**

* Full-time: 40 hours per week
* On-site training and career development
* Paid holidays, WFH days and paid time off
* Insurance benefits including but not limited to: Health, vision, dental, life, and disability
* 401(k) Plan

  
**Additional Information**

**Additional Information**

* Competitive base salary commensurate with experience
* Direct exposure to executive leadership and substantive matter ownership from day one
* On-site training and career development with a fast track to promotion
* Insurance benefits including: Health, vision, dental, life, and disability
* Paid holidays and paid time off after 90 days
